 Job Description

 Bij Telenet geloven we dat data, analytics en (Gen)AI de belangrijkste drijfveren zijn achter onze digitale transformatie. Data wordt gebruikt om onze klanten beter te begrijpen, slimmere besluitvorming te ondersteunen en innovatieve AI-gedreven oplossingen mogelijk te maken.

Binnen Telenet speelt de Data & AI Tribe een centrale rol in het ontsluiten van de waarde van data en (Gen)AI in de hele organisatie, van strategie tot uitvoering.

Als Senior Data & AI Governance Expert kom je terecht in het Data & AI Governance Team, waar je helpt bij het vormgeven van robuuste, schaalbare en toekomstbestendige governancepraktijken die ervoor zorgen dat onze data- en (Gen)AI-producten waardegedreven, veilig en compliant zijn.

 Je taken als Data & AI Governance Expert

 Als Data & AI Governance Expert Speel Je Een Sleutelrol In Het Definiëren, Operationaliseren En Integreren Van Data & AI Governance Binnen Telenet

 Het ontwerpen en operationaliseren van een data & AI governance-raamwerk dat is afgestemd op onze agile, productgerichte manier van werken 
 Het definiëren van beleid, richtlijnen en processen voor zowel gestructureerde als ongestructureerde dataclassificatie, eigendom, datakwaliteit, afkomst, catalogisering en levenscyclusbeheer 
 Het integreren van governance in tools en workflows, waarbij waar mogelijk policy-as-code wordt toegepast (bijv. policy scoring, AI risk assessment, product catalogus, metadata management, unstructured data tagging, ...) 
 Het aansturen van ons enterprise data governance-platform, waaronder:
 het implementeren en optimaliseren van workflows (bijv. onboarding van dataproducten, ownership, policy scoring, risicoscreening) 
 het definiëren en onderhouden van metadatamodellen, bedrijfsmodellen en governance-rollen 
 het vergroten van de acceptatie en bruikbaarheid door middel van betrokkenheid van belanghebbenden, training en voortdurende verbetering 
 Het beheren van AI-, GenAI- en GenBI-gebruiksscenario's, waaronder semantisch laagbeheer, risicobeoordelingen, verantwoordelijke AI-controles en modelbeheer 
 Nauw samenwerken met Product Owners, productmanagers, data analysten, architecten, beveiligings- en juridische teams om ervoor te zorgen dat governance praktisch is en in de dagelijkse activiteiten is ingebed 
 Definitie, monitoring en rapportage van governance-KPI's, compliance-indicatoren en risicometrics 
 Het stimuleren van acceptatie en verandering door middel van coaching, training en continue verbetering van governancepraktijken 

 Onze ideale Data & AI Governance Expert

 Je Beschikt Over De Volgende Ervaring En Mindset

 Een senior professional met meer dan 5 jaar ervaring in datagovernance, informatiemanagement of aanverwante domeinen
 Masterdiploma in een kwantitatief vakgebied (business engineering, toegepaste economie, computerwetenschappen, informatiemanagement) of gelijkwaardig door ervaring
 Aantoonbare ervaring met enterprise data & AI governance platforms, o.a. workflow configuratie, training en het stimuleren van acceptatie binnen de organisatie
 Sterke expertise in het vertalen van beleid naar operationele processen in complexe omgevingen met meerdere stakeholders
 Gedegen kennis van data & AI wetgeving (EU AI act, GDPR, …) en governance best-practices (metadata, quality, ownership, …)
 Ervaring met AI/ML-governance, modelrisicobeheer of responsible AI is een sterk pluspunt
 Comfortabel in het werken met zowel technische als business stakeholders 


 Ons aanbod voor jou

 Bij Telenet group krijg je meer dan alleen een aantrekkelijk brutoloon. We geloven sterk in resultaten en ownership : we geven vertrouwen, maar verwachten ook engagement en impact. Wat jij realiseert, telt echt.

Naast een dertiende maand en vakantiegeld kan je rekenen op een uitgebreid pakket aan extralegale voordelen dat je ondersteunt in je dagelijkse leven én je werk.

 Wat mag je concreet verwachten?

 Mobiliteitsbudget: stel zelf je mobiliteitsplan samen, met keuze voor een bedrijfswagen of alternatieve vervoersoplossingen 
 Maaltijdcheques en ecocheques 
 Smartphone, mobiel abonnement, laptop en personeelskorting 
 Collectieve bonus en individuele bonus (afgestemd op jouw prestaties) 
 Hospitalisatieverzekering (inclusief ambulant plan) en groepsverzekering 
 20 wettelijke verlofdagen en 12 ADV-dagen 


 We vinden het belangrijk dat je je kan blijven ontwikkelen. Daarom investeren we in jouw groei via ons intern leerplatform , coaching en leren op de werkvloer. Je krijgt kansen om bij te leren en jezelf verder te versterken in je rol.

Samenwerken doen we het liefst van dichtbij. We geloven dat sterke teams ontstaan door elkaar regelmatig te zien en snel te kunnen schakelen. Daarom verwachten we dat je als nieuwe collega minimum drie dagen per week op kantoor werkt gedurende de eerste zes maanden. De overige dagen kan je van thuis werken.

 Zie jij jezelf in deze rol? Dan kijken we uit naar je sollicitatie. We laten altijd iets van ons horen. Wanneer je wordt meegenomen in de eerste selectie, nemen we contact met je op om kennis te maken en lichten we de volgende stappen van ons selectieproces toe.

 Vous êtes un(e) AI Program Manager expérimenté(e), passionné(e) par le déploiement et le pilotage de roadmaps d'IA générative ambitieuses ? Artefact Belgique recherche un(e) Chef(fe) de Programme IA pour stimuler l'innovation et concevoir des solutions fondées sur l'IA pour nos clients internationaux. Si vous possédez une solide expérience en pilotage de programmes transversaux, en transformation digitale et en conseil, nous vous invitons à façonner avec nous l'avenir des solutions basées sur l'IA à Bruxelles.

 Qui nous sommes

 Fondé à Paris, Artefact est un cabinet de conseil de nouvelle génération spécialisé dans la data, l'analytics et l'IA, dont l'objectif est de transformer les données en impact business. Nous aidons nos clients à développer leurs capacités data et numériques tout en faisant évoluer nos propres compétences. En Belgique, notre équipe d'ingénierie et de conseil travaille sur les applications les plus avancées des technologies de la data, qu'il s'agisse du soutien à des projets de GenAI de pointe, du déploiement d'agents IA ou du pilotage stratégique de roadmaps d'innovation. Notre culture inclusive et tournée vers l'avenir encourage la créativité, la collaboration et l'épanouissement professionnel.

 En tant qu' AI Program Manager , vous êtes responsable du déploiement et du pilotage d'une roadmap GenAI ambitieuse pour nos clients, couvrant l'ensemble des fonctions de l'entreprise (Support, Opérations, Qualité, Sécurité, RH, Finance, etc.).

 Identifier des partenaires potentiels et des solutions technologiques innovantes en lien avec les référents technologiques.
 Collaborer avec les différentes entités et écosystèmes pour identifier et appliquer les meilleures pratiques du marché.
 Réaliser des revues d'opportunités régulières avec la direction.
 Pilotage de la roadmap GenAI
 Structurer et piloter la roadmap sous forme de programmes opérationnels.
 Recenser les besoins au plus proche des métiers.
 Prioriser les cas d'usage selon les gains business, la maturité technique, ainsi que les risques et dépendances.
 Suivre les jalons clés (PoC, pilote, déploiement, généralisation).
 Gouvernance & reporting exécutif
 Mettre en place et animer la gouvernance GenAI.
 Garantir la conformité des projets : sécurité des données, respect du RGPD, de l'AI Act et des standards d'entreprise.
 Produire un reporting clair, synthétique et orienté décision pour les instances de gouvernance et comités exécutifs.
 Delivery & industrialisation
 Piloter le passage progressif des projets du PoC au pilote, puis au déploiement industriel.
 Assurer la cohérence entre les solutions locales et les plateformes mutualisées.
 Sécuriser la qualité, la robustesse et la maintenabilité des solutions déployées.
 Coordination transverse
 Orchestrer l'ensemble des acteurs impliqués : métiers, équipes Data / IT / Cybersécurité, et partenaires externes.
 Arbitrer les priorités interdomaines en accord avec la stratégie globale.
 Adoption, compétences & conduite du changement
 Piloter l’adoption des utilisateurs (Copilots, agents GenAI, assistants métiers).
 Structurer des dispositifs de formation adaptés (e-learning, réseau de champions, communication interne).
 Mesurer l’usage réel des solutions et la valeur créée sur le terrain.

 Formation : Formation supérieure de type école d'ingénieur, école de commerce, informatique, data/IA ou équivalent.
 Expérience : Expérience confirmée en pilotage de programmes digitaux, data ou IA dans des environnements complexes (le secteur du conseil est un atout).
 Gestion de portefeuille : Capacité démontrée à structurer, prioriser et suivre un portefeuille de cas d'usage, depuis l'idéation jusqu'au déploiement à grande échelle.
 Culture technique & GenAI : Bonne compréhension des technologies GenAI, des assistants métiers, de l'automatisation, des plateformes data et des solutions digitales.

 Capgemini Invent enables company leaders to envision and shape the future of their businesses. Located in more than 30 offices and creative studios around the world, Capgemini comprises a 1,000+ strong team of strategists, data scientists, product and experience designers, brand experts and technologists who develop new digital services, products and business models for sustainable growth.
 

 YOUR ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES 
 

 As a Data Strategist , you help organizations turn data into a strategic asset by defining how it is structured, governed, and used to enable decision-making, analytics, and AI at scale.
 You combine a strong understanding of data management fundamentals with a pragmatic approach to embedding data practices within business operations. You ensure that data is not only governed, but also structured, interpretable, and usable across the organization, including through semantic layers and shared business definitions and AI-ready data foundations.
 

 

 Your role includes: 
 Define data strategies and operating models that enable analytics and AI at scale
 Design and embed data governance frameworks that ensure data is trusted, usable, and business-aligned
 Drive data quality and data management practices to improve reliability and decision-making
 Assess data maturity and translate insights into actionable transformation roadmaps
 Advise on modern data platforms (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks), semantic layers, and governance tools (e.g. Collibra, Purview), ensuring alignment between business needs and technology implementation
 Support the transition toward data-as-a-product and domain-based data ownership
 Translate business requirements into clear specifications and coordinate with data and IT teams during delivery
 Contribute to responsible AI and data ethics by defining principles and governance mechanisms for AI use
 

 

 

 REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 
 

 A master’s degree in business engineering, applied economics, computer science, data science, information technology, or a related field
 3 to 5 years of experience in data strategy, governance and enablement
 Hands‑on experience with data governance, data quality tools (from a business or functional perspective)
 Ability to work comfortably at the intersection of business and technology
 Fluency in English and Dutch or French
 

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 
 

 Good understanding of data architecture principles, data modelling, and the end‑to‑end data lifecycle
 Practical familiarity with data governance frameworks (e.g. DAMA), with the ability to apply them pragmatically rather than theoretically
 Experience contributing to governance initiatives in large, complex, or regulated environments
 Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain governance concepts to both business and technical audiences
 A proactive and ownership‑driven mindset, with curiosity to explore topics related to data governance, Data & AI, and emerging regulations
 

 

 

 WHAT WE OFFER 
 

 At Capgemini , we actively embody our motto: " Get the future you want ":
 A stimulating and intellectually challenging role within a leading management consulting company
 An interesting salary package including a company car or mobility budget, fringe benefits
 A clear and direct career path with ample growth potential, within a dynamic and diverse team
 Autonomy to shape your growth path, with opportunities to work on initiatives that align with your interests and capabilities
 Tailored Training and Personal Development opportunities to support your professional ambitions
 Flexible working arrangements, encompassing teleworking, flexible working hours, and opportunities for working abroad
 Personalized mentoring provided by a dedicated counselor to facilitate your personal and professional growth within the organization
 An inspiring and collaborative atmosphere, emphasizing team building, engaging team events, and a touch of after-work enjoyment!
 

 

 Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

 You have an agile, growth-oriented mindset. What you know matters. But the right mindset is just as important in determining success. We’re looking for people who are innovative, can work in an agile way and keep pace with a rapidly changing world.
 You are curious and purpose driven. We’re looking for people who see opportunities instead of challenges, who ask better questions to seek better answers that build a better working world.

li-4449096695.title: Beleidsmedewerker AI in onderzoeks- en doctoraatsbeleid (m/v/x)
li-4449096695.description:
show-more-less-html__markup--clamp-after-5
 relative overflow-hidden">
 HEB JE NOG VRAGEN OVER DEZE VACATURE?

Je vindt de gegevens van de contactpersoon in de vacaturetekst.

 1 - Werken bij de VUB in een veranderende context van AI

 De Vrije Universiteit Brussel staat al meer dan 50 jaar voor vrijheid, gelijk(waardig)heid en verbondenheid en dat leeft sterk op onze campussen bij zowel studenten als personeel. Bij de VUB vind je een diverse verzameling aan persoonlijkheden: innovators pur sang, maar vooral mensen die 100% hun authentieke zelf zijn . Met zo’n 4000 medewerkers zijn we de grootste Nederlandstalige werkgever, in de privésector, in Brussel; een internationale stad waarmee we ons maar al te graag verbinden en waar(rond) onze 4 campussen gelegen zijn.

AI verandert in snel tempo hoe onderzoek wordt uitgevoerd, begeleid en geëvalueerd. De Vrije Universiteit Brussel wil hier proactief op inspelen: Hoe evolueert het doctoraatstraject onder invloed van AI, en hoe moet doctoraatsonderzoek en -begeleiding daardoor worden herdacht? Welke vaardigheden hebben onze onderzoekers vandaag en in de nabije toekomst nodig om op een kritische manier met deze nieuwe tools om te gaan? Wat is de rol van de promotor? Wat met vakgebieden waarin AI bovenmenselijke prestaties levert? Hoe blijf je als instelling nog competitief in fondsenwerving? Welke evaluatiecriteria zijn nog houdbaar, en welke moeten worden herzien - in eerste instantie met betrekking tot doctoraten en doctoraatsbegeleiding, maar bij uitbreiding ook voor onderzoeksevaluatie in het algemeen?

Om op deze vragen een gedragen antwoord te bieden, willen we een AI-werkgroep oprichten die verschillende vertegenwoordigers samenbrengt uit de universiteit. Deze werkgroep moet uitmonden in concreet beleid en/of reglementering rond AI in onderzoek en doctoraatsbeleid.

In deze functie werk je nauw samen binnen het vicerectoraat Onderzoek met de teams Researcher Training & Development, Research Policy en de AI-beleidsmedewerker die zich focust op ontwikkelingen van tools en hoe deze optimaal in te zetten voor zowel onderzoekers als binnen het departement zelf.

 2 - Functiebeschrijving

 In deze functie werk je nauw samen binnen het vicerectoraat Onderzoek met de teams Researcher Training & Development, Research Policy en de AI-beleidsmedewerker die zich focust op ontwikkelingen van tools en hoe deze optimaal in te zetten voor zowel onderzoekers als binnen het departement zelf.

Als beleidsmedewerker AI in onderzoeks- en doctoraatsbeleid

 Leid je de AI-werkgroep onderzoek & doctoraatsbeleid: je voorziet een evenwichtige werkgroep, plant en modereert de werkzaamheden, en zorgt voor voortgang en resultaatgerichtheid.
 Volg je de externe omgeving op: wetgeving, praktijken aan andere universiteiten en onderzoeksfinancierders (bv. FWO, Europese Commissie) rond AI en onderzoeksintegriteit.
 Vertaal je de output van de AI-werkgroep naar concrete aanbevelingen voor beleid en/of reglementering, en stel je deze voor op diverse bestuursorganen.
 Breng je een gedragen visie tot stand op de vraag welke vaardigheden onderzoekers (van doctorandi tot senior onderzoekers) in de nabije toekomst nodig hebben, en vertaal je dit naar aanbevelingen voor vorming en ondersteuning.
 Herdenk je mee hoe het doctoraatstraject — inhoud, begeleiding, output, originaliteitsvereisten — zich moet verhouden tot het gebruik van AI.
 Geef je vorm aan vernieuwde evaluatiecriteria en -kaders voor doctoraatsonderzoek en -verdediging rekening houdend met (inter)nationale ontwikkelingen en met aandacht voor onderzoeksintegriteit.
 Werk je structureel samen met andere beleidsmedewerkers (doctoraten en doctoraatsbegeleiding, onderzoeksevaluatie) en in het bijzonder ook de AI-tools beleidsmedewerker zodat alle Research-teams optimaal op elkaar zijn afgestemd.
 Stel je pakketten van cursussen samen voor onderzoekers in samenspraak met de AI-tools beleidsmedewerker en/of geef je zelf workshops aan onderzoekers.
 Communiceer en sensibiliseer je binnen de instelling over de voortgang en de uiteindelijke beleidskeuzes, in samenwerking met communicatiemedewerkers.
 Zorg je voor de implementatie en opvolging van het nieuwe beleid na goedkeuring, inclusief eventuele bijsturing.


 3 - Profiel

 Wat verwachten wij van jou?

 Je hebt een doctoraat of een masterdiploma plus ervaring binnen een onderzoeksomgeving (universiteit, onderzoeksinstelling).
 Je hebt aantoonbare affiniteit met en kennis van AI-ontwikkelingen, in het bijzonder een basisinzicht in hun werking, beperkingen en potentieel, en hun huidige impact op onderzoek en hoger onderwijs (je hoeft geen AI-expert te zijn, maar je moet de materie snel en grondig kunnen doorgronden). Je schoolt je snel bij naarmate de technologie verder evolueert.
 Je hebt ervaring met of een uitgesproken interesse in beleidsontwikkeling, reglementering en/of governance binnen een complexe organisatie.
 Je hebt sterke kennis van of affiniteit met doctoraatstrajecten- en opleidingen of bent bereid je hier snel in te verdiepen.
 Je hebt goed inzicht in wie stakeholders zijn, reikt proactief naar stakeholders uit en werkt graag samen met anderen
 Je kan groepen met uiteenlopende belangen en achtergronden samenbrengen, faciliteren en tot een gezamenlijk resultaat leiden.
 Je bent een sterke, heldere communicator, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk (nota's, beleidsteksten, presentaties).
 Je werkt zelfstandig, houdt overzicht op een meerjarig traject en kan prioriteiten stellen.
 Als (niet-) EER onderdaan voldoen aan de voorwaarden voor het verkrijgen van een rechtsgeldige vergunning voor VUB en voldoen aan de VUB verblijfsvoorwaarden. Lees hier meer.


 Een Pluspunt Kan Verder Zijn Wanneer

 Je voeling hebt met (of leert snel) de interne besluitvormingsstructuren en -cultuur van een universiteit of de VUB in het bijzonder.
 Ervaring hebt met verandertrajecten of beleidsprocessen in een academische of publieke context.
 Kennis kunt tonen omtrent onderzoeksintegriteit en de relevante kaders (bv. Europese Gedragscode voor Onderzoeksintegriteit).


 VUB wil een weerspiegeling zijn van de maatschappij waar ieders talent wordt gewaardeerd, ongeacht het gender, geslacht, leeftijd, religie, huidskleur, migratieachtergrond, functiebeperking en de neurodiversiteit.

 4 - Aanbod

 We bieden je een voltijds contract van bepaalde duur (twee jaar) aan als beleidsmedewerker (gradengroep 7-8-9). Het salaris is afhankelijk van je competenties en het aantal jaren relevante werkervaring. Het is bespreekbaar om af te wijken van een voltijds regime, bijvoorbeeld in combinatie met een beperkte onderzoeksfunctie.

 Flexible working arrangements - We are proud of our flexible working arrangements. We will actively support you in building a successful career and delivering excellent client service without sacrificing your personal priorities.  Location - All of our offices are easily accessible by public transport and/or by car and have parking space. They all have parking spaces and charging stations are provided.

 About The Team

 OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We believe that achieving our goal requires effective engagement with public policy stakeholders and the broader community impacted by AI. Accordingly, our Global Affairs team builds authentic, collaborative relationships with public officials and the broader AI policymaking community to inform and support our shared work in these domains. We ensure that insights from policymakers inform our work and - in collaboration with our colleagues and external stakeholders - support the development of regulation, industry standards, and safe and beneficial development of AI tools.

 About The Role

 As the EU Policy & Partnerships Manager, you will develop strategies, shape OpenAI’s approach to priority EU policy issues, and drive campaigns as part of our European team. You will also develop and manage relationships with key stakeholders across the Brussels policy ecosystem, including policymakers, regulators, civil society groups, industry associations, researchers and experts, seeking to advance policies and partnerships that align with OpenAI’s mission.

OpenAI releases industry-leading research and tools. You will face new challenges as the impact of cutting-edge generative AI technologies continues to be explored and as the needs of the organization evolve. Day-to-day work may encompass anything from helping to shape strategic initiatives and developing policy positions to preparing our leaders for engagements with EU officials or representing OpenAI in private and public forums.

We are looking for a self-directed and creative individual with deep EU policy expertise, experience managing relationships across the Brussels policy ecosystem, sound judgment, and a sophisticated understanding of AI and AI-related legislative and regulatory issues and processes. The ideal candidate will be able to move between strategic policy development and practical delivery, working across teams to advance OpenAI’s mission in Brussels.

This strategic yet hands-on role will report to the EU Policy & Partnerships Lead and work closely with key internal and external partners.

This role is based in our Brussels office and will involve occasional travel. We follow a hybrid work model with three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

 You Should Thrive In This Role If You

 Have deep knowledge of the EU policy ecosystem, including the institutions, legislative and regulatory processes, key debates shaping AI and technology policy, and a solid understanding of the member state policy landscape.
 Are a trusted relationship builder who can engage credibly with EU officials, regulators, civil society groups, industry associations, researchers and experts across the Brussels policy ecosystem.
 Can translate complex AI concepts into practical policy relevance for EU policymakers and Brussels stakeholders.
 Are comfortable operating independently while collaborating closely across teams in a fast-moving environment.
 Are passionate about the promise of technology and the future of artificial intelligence but thoughtful about its potential risks.


 We're Looking For a Blend Of

 Experience working at the intersection of technology, policy, and politics and translating complex socio-technical issues to diverse audiences.
 Deep expertise in one or more priority EU policy issues relevant to OpenAI.
 An established network and credibility with EU policymakers, regulators, civil society groups, industry associations, researchers, experts, and other key stakeholders across the Brussels policy ecosystem.
 Demonstrated ability to analyze and engage on complex regulatory and legislative proposals, including reviewing draft text, developing positions, and supporting negotiations.
 Experience driving external policy initiatives, such as thought leadership, white papers, and participation in industry coalitions, that advance responsible technology development and policy positions.
 Excellent written and oral communication and presentation skills in English, with experience briefing senior stakeholders; additional EU languages are a plus.
 Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and project management skills.
 Ability to execute in fast and flexible environments through rapid cycles of analysis, decision, and action.
 Track record of effectively working with cross-functional teams and aligning a diverse range of internal and external partners.
 Sound judgment, discretion, and outstanding personal integrity.
 Genuine care and knowledge about the impact of technology on society.


 About OpenAI

 OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

 AI is moving from isolated experiments to something organisations have to run at scale: more use cases, more teams, more exposure. Most companies aren't set up for it. They lack the operating model, the guardrails and the shared language to adopt AI responsibly and actually capture its value.

We're looking for a consultant who can help clients manage AI well, from individual use cases up to portfolio scale. You'll set up the governance, risk management, quality checks and lifecycle processes that turn scattered pilots into a managed portfolio, and you'll drive the organisational change that makes it stick. You're not a lawyer and you're not a data scientist? Good. We want a strategy-minded consultant who understands how AI lands inside an organisation and can run engagements from framing the problem with a client's leadership to helping them adopt the solution.

 Your Responsibilities

 Set up AI portfolio management

 Design AI governance operating models: roles, decision rights, intake and approval flows
 Build the AI lifecycle process, from intake and risk triage through deployment, monitoring and retirement
 Drive the organisational change that makes it work: onboarding stakeholders, embedding ways of working, building internal capability rather than a document nobody reads
 Set up inventories and registries so clients know what AI they run and how it performs
 Conduct comprehensive AI risk assessments and ethical evaluations for client systems



 Manage risk and quality

 Design AI risk management approaches that integrate the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 into something practical for the client
 Run AI risk assessments and guide individual use cases through classification, mitigation and sign-off

 Keep clients ahead of a fast-moving regulatory and standards landscape

 Experience identifying and managing risk (AI, data, technology or compliance: bias, privacy, security, robustness, transparency)

 Bedrijfsomschrijving

 Sopra Steria biedt op maat gemaakte end-to-end corporate technolgy en software solutions aan die organisaties helpen gedurfde keuzes te maken en resultaten te boeken. En met succes! Met meer dan 51.000 collega’s in bijna 30 landen behoren we tot de top van de Europese digital solutions leveranciers. Succesvolle organisaties in Europa vertrouwen op onze technologie omdat we blijven streven naar innovatie, samenwerking en zakelijke ontwikkeling.

The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.

 Vacatureomschrijving

 Word deel van ons Data & AI-team

 Als AI Analist maak je deel uit van een multidisciplinair Data & AI-team dat organisaties helpt hun AI-ambities om te zetten in concrete initiatieven met meetbare businesswaarde. Je werkt nauw samen met experts in data engineering, architectuur, AI, analytics, governance en datavisualisatie om opportuniteiten te identificeren, stakeholders op één lijn te krijgen en businessuitdagingen te vertalen naar haalbare AI-oplossingen .

In deze rol vorm je de brug tussen business stakeholders, datateams en AI-specialisten . Je helpt organisaties verder te kijken dan de hype rond AI en focust op hoe AI daadwerkelijk waarde kan creëren voor hun activiteiten en strategische doelstellingen.

Je faciliteert workshops, brengt AI-use cases in kaart en beoordeelt zowel hun zakelijke relevantie als technische haalbaarheid. Daarnaast vertaal je businessnoden naar duidelijke AI-vereisten en werk je samen met management, AI Architects, AI Engineers, Data Scientists en andere experts om klanten te ondersteunen bij het maken van onderbouwde keuzes rond AI-investeringen.

Tijdens de eerste fases van hun AI-transformatie begeleid je klanten bij het:

 beoordelen van hun AI- en datamaturiteit;
 evalueren van de data readiness binnen de organisatie;
 opstellen van business cases en value assessments;
 identificeren en prioriteren van AI-initiatieven.


 Je weet complexe AI-concepten helder uit te leggen aan niet-technische stakeholders en slaagt er tegelijk in om businessdoelstellingen, randvoorwaarden en succescriteria duidelijk over te brengen naar technische teams. Je begrijpt de verschillen tussen traditionele AI, Generative AI en Agentic AI en kunt organisaties adviseren over de meest geschikte toepassingen.

Daarnaast ondersteun je klanten bij governance-, compliance- en organisatievraagstukken rond AI-adoptie. Daarbij hou je rekening met thema's zoals datakwaliteit, Responsible AI en relevante regelgeving, waaronder GDPR en de Europese AI Act.

 Functie-eisen

 Wij zoeken een AI Analist die sterke analytische vaardigheden combineert met een consultancy-mindset. Je kunt bedrijfsdoelstellingen vertalen naar concrete AI-opportuniteiten en stakeholders begeleiden naar waardevolle beslissingen.

 Je hebt kennis van en ervaring met:

 Minstens 4 jaar ervaring in business analyse, data & analytics, consulting, product ownership of een vergelijkbare rol.
 Ervaring met het uitwerken van AI-roadmaps en het vertalen van businessnoden naar functionele, analytische of AI-gerelateerde requirements.
 Sterke vaardigheden in stakeholder management, presentatie en workshopfacilitatie.
 Ervaring met het identificeren, evalueren en prioriteren van business opportuniteiten en transformatie-initiatieven.
 Ervaring in het opstellen van business cases, value assessments en haalbaarheidsanalyses.
 Een goed begrip van AI-mogelijkheden en use cases, waaronder Traditional AI, Generative AI en Agentic AI.
 Inzicht in AI- en data maturity assessments en concepten zoals data readiness.
 Kennis van AI-platformen, dataplatformen en het bredere AI-ecosysteem.
 Vertrouwdheid met AI governance, Responsible AI-principes en regelgeving zoals GDPR en de EU AI Act. Ervaring met sectorspecifieke regelgeving is een plus.
 Kennis van change management en AI-adoptiestrategieën is een troef.
 Je communiceert vlot in het Engels en daarnaast in het Nederlands of Frans.


 Wat mag je van ons verwachten?

 Je komt terecht in onze Data Science & AI Practice , onderdeel van het bredere Data & AI-team. Samen met een team van ervaren consultants help je organisaties om maximaal rendement te halen uit hun investeringen in data en AI.

Onze expertise strekt zich uit van AI-strategie en use-case discovery tot business value assessment, governance, operating models en AI-transformatie. We helpen klanten inzicht te krijgen in waar AI écht impact kan maken , welke opportuniteiten prioriteit verdienen en welke fundamenten nodig zijn om AI op een duurzame manier te implementeren.

 Binnen deze rol krijg je de kans om je verder te ontwikkelen op het vlak van:

 AI-strategie en innovatie;
 AI governance en Responsible AI;
 stakeholder management;
 business consulting;
 waarde-gedreven transformatie.


 Je maakt deel uit van een open en collaboratieve omgeving waarin kennisdeling, coaching en continue ontwikkeling centraal staan.

Bovendien krijg je toegang tot uitgebreide doorgroeimogelijkheden, zowel in België als internationaal, ondersteund door de Sopra Steria Academy en een wereldwijd netwerk van meer dan 51.000 collega's en experts .

 Aanvullende informatie

 We bieden een aantrekkelijk voordelenpakket, waaronder:

 Een waaier aan extralegale voordelen, zoals mobiliteitsopties (inclusief een bedrijfswagen), verzekeringsdekking, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques en meer.
 Voortdurende leermogelijkheden via de Sopra Steria Academy zodat je je professioneel kan blijven ontwikkelen.
 De kans om je collega’s van Sopra Steria te ontmoeten tijdens diverse teamevents.


 Lijkt deze job iets voor jou?

 Ben je klaar om met ons de wereld vorm te geven? Fantastisch! We kijken nu al uit naar jouw sollicitatie.

______

We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

li-4404444549.description:
show-more-less-html__markup--clamp-after-5
 relative overflow-hidden">
 About us 
 We're an independent European digital product studio with a strong track record of delivering market-defining strategies, products and platforms for enterprises and governments. With about 200 talented people across three countries, premium AI capabilities and a diverse portfolio of international clients, we define, design and ship at scale and with impact. From global cloud-based platforms, AI-systems and large-audience apps to medical devices, banking software and full AI Transformation roadmaps. We live and breathe digital.
 

 Become a part of our team 
 At In The Pocket, you join a multidisciplinary team of designers, engineers, strategists and AI specialists who care about the work as much as the people they work with. We work in small, autonomous teams that stay close to our clients and their users, and we give everyone the space to take ownership, speak up and grow. You'll learn from colleagues across our studios, impact thousands or even millions of people with your work and help shape our business in the age of intelligence.
 

 What you’ll do 
 AI is rewriting how organisations operate and compete. Many of our clients know they need to act, but struggle with where to start, what to prioritise and how to scale AI beyond the proof of concept. That's where you come in.
 

 As a Senior AI Transformation Consultant, you help organisations see their future through the lens of AI and give them the framework to work towards it. You work across strategy, organisational design and applied AI, moving fluidly between a boardroom workshop and a hands-on pilot with a product team. You're comfortable telling a CEO which bets to make and equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves to define the use case, sketch the architecture and plan the rollout. You'll operate from our studios in Ghent, Antwerp or Leuven, but this is a client-facing role. You should be open to prolonged embedded assignments at enterprise and government clients, leading their AI transformation on-site as a trusted advisor who's part of their daily rhythm, not a consultant who flies in for a slide deck.
 

 You'll work within our AI Transformation team, which covers three areas: Organisational AI Readiness, AI Discovery and Applied AI. These areas require different focus and expertise, we’re curious to hear where you thrive and excel (and where you don’t). In The Pocket has developed a proprietary and successful approach to AI Transformation, which you’ll champion across industries, such as healthcare, government, utilities, retail and finance.
 

 Help organisations get AI-ready: 
 Assess a client's organisational maturity for AI adoption: governance, tooling, data foundations, capabilities.
 Design and set up an AI Centre of Excellence: the team, the mandate, the decision rights, the guardrails and the metrics. The goal is to unify scattered AI efforts under shared standards while giving teams enough room to move fast.
 Define the AI orchestration layer: how models, agents and automation are governed, made available and kept under financial and compliance control across the organisation.
 Map an organisation's capabilities to create a framework for distributed ownership of AI initiatives, making it clear where AI shifts value creation and who's accountable
 

 Discover where AI creates value: 
 Facilitate workshop series to uncover and prioritise AI use cases for a client, producing a growth map ranked by value and feasibility, with clear owners, timelines and success metrics.
 Develop AI differentiation strategies: where can this client build a competitive edge through? What will their competitors do, and what can they do that's different?
 Create solution concept sketches, stakeholder maps and data requirement overviews for the top-priority use cases.
 Build roadmaps that balance quick wins with longer-term foundational investments, so clients can show results while laying the groundwork for scale.
 

 Get AI into production: 
 Scope, plan and guide AI pilot projects from defining success criteria to shipping a working solution that proves value and builds internal buy-in.
 Define KPI’s and evaluation frameworks focused on impact and outcome.
 Lead the path from pilot to production. Define KPIs and evaluation frameworks that prove impact and guide clients through the inevitable gap between a successful pilot and a production-ready solution.
 

 Ensure responsible adoption: 
 Embed privacy, security and compliance into AI initiatives from day one. We're ISO 27001-certified and work in regulated industries. You should be comfortable in that context.
 Keep governance aligned with evolving regulation, including the EU AI Act.
 Promote human-first AI principles: AI as augmentation, not replacement. Help teams adopt AI in a way that feels safe and makes sense for their day-to-day work.
 

 Grow the practice: 
 Contribute to the development of our AI Transformation frameworks, playbooks and toolkits.
 Support our Sales team and help shape proposals and pitches for new AI transformation engagements.
 Coach and mentor more junior consultants across engagements.
 Share knowledge across In The Pocket and with the broader market through talks, articles or workshops.
 

 Who you are 
 You have 7+ years of professional experience, with at least 3 years in consulting, digital strategy or transformation roles serving enterprise or public-sector clients.
 You thrive working on-site with clients, building long-lasting relationships rather than doing research from a distance.
 You have a solid grasp of AI and machine learning concepts — not necessarily as an engineer, but enough to have credible conversations about what's possible, what's practical and what's hype. You can partner with engineering and data teams without needing to be walked through the basics.
 You've led or been deeply involved in organisational change programmes. You know that shipping the technology is half the job; the other half is adoption and change.
 You can run a workshop with senior stakeholders, synthesise findings into a clear strategy and present it back with confidence. You don't hide uncertainty from executives; you explain trade-offs honestly.
 You think in terms of business outcomes, not features.
 You have experience with capability mapping, operating model design, data governance or similar organisational disciplines. You don't need all of these, but you should have depth in at least one.
 You're familiar with the current AI landscape: foundation models, agentic workflows, AI orchestration platforms, the buy-vs-build trade-offs companies face.
 You’ve learned to think and work “AI-first” and are a fluent orchestrator of various relevant AI-tools.
 You write well and you’re a great communicator. Discrete when required and on stage when the opportunity presents itself.
 You're comfortable with prolonged on-site engagements at client organisations. This role isn't remote-first — you'll spend real time in our studios and at client locations across Belgium and occasionally beyond.
 You're fluent in Dutch and English, with strong communication and presentation skills in both. French speaking ability is a strong plus.
 You are looking for a permanent full-time position.
 

 What we offer 
 Joining In The Pocket means becoming part of a team that shapes the future of our clients’ businesses across Europe. Here’s what you can look forward to:
 

 You’ll start with a permanent contract in a role that comes with responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact from day one.
 We offer a competitive salary that reflects your experience and the value you bring.
 Our benefits package has you covered with hospitalisation and group insurance, meal vouchers, a phone subscription, and more.
 You’ll have a mobility budget that lets you decide how to get around, your way.
 Life at In The Pocket isn’t just about work, we host team events throughout the year to celebrate, connect, and have fun together.
 Learning never stops here, so after six months, you’ll receive a dedicated learning and development budget to keep growing your skills and exploring new horizons.
 

 At In The Pocket, we use artificial intelligence to support and not replace human judgment. AI can assist our Talent Acquisition processes by helping to pre-screen applications, analyze and summarize CV's and identify skills gaps.
 

 Human oversight is always applied when inviting candidates to interviews. Our Talent Acquisition team reviews AI-supported insights and make the final decision to ensure relevance, fairness, and thoughtful consideration of each candidate’s unique profile.
 Human managers always make the final hiring decisions to ensure fairness, context, and accountability.
 

 AI is a tool to support people, not a substitute for human responsibility.

 Job Description

 Job Family

 Product Owner – AI‑Enabled Products

 The Product Owner represents the business within the squad and acts as the primary interface for demand intake , including AI‑enabled, data‑driven, and automation use cases .

The Product Owner reflects accepted demand on the squad backlog and prioritizes it according to business value, strategic priorities, regulatory constraints (banking license), and AI risk posture .

 Role Purpose

 The Product Owner is the guardian of product fitness for purpose , ensuring that functional, non‑functional, and AI‑specific requirements are met for products of limited complexity, uncertainty, and dependencies (e.g. mature products, end‑of‑life systems, or products with a well‑defined operational scope).

This includes ensuring that AI components (models, data pipelines, decision logic, automation) are:

 Fit for business intent
 Compliant with regulatory and ethical standards
 Operationally robust and explainable


 Description & Responsibilities

 Product Ownership & Business Value (AI‑Aware)
 Act as end‑to‑end owner of the product, including:
 Functional requirements
 Non‑functional requirements (performance, security, resilience)
 AI‑specific qualities such as explainability, data quality, bias awareness, and model lifecycle sustainability
 Link business value to the Product Backlog, explicitly identifying:
 Where AI or automation contributes to efficiency, risk reduction, or customer value
 Where non‑AI solutions are preferable, ensuring pragmatic and value‑driven decisions
 Represent the business intent behind AI usage, ensuring the squad understands:
 Why AI is used
 What decisions it supports or automates
 What human oversight is required
 Stakeholder & Customer Centricity (AI Context)
 Identify and manage stakeholders (business sponsors, operations, risk (EU AI Risks associated as well), compliance, legal, IT, data, architecture).
 Collect and federate stakeholder input on:
 Business outcomes
 Regulatory constraints
 AI acceptability (risk appetite, explainability, auditability)
 Guide the squad towards customer‑centric and user‑centric AI solutions, ensuring:
 Transparency of AI‑driven decisions
 Clear communication of AI limitations and confidence levels
 Backlog Management & Story Definition (AI‑Ready)
 Own and manage the Product Backlog, ensuring it is:
 Complete, transparent, prioritized, and understood
 Inclusive of AI lifecycle work, not just features
 Effectively write and slice stories that may include:
 Data sourcing and preparation
 Feature engineering (transforming raw data into model‑ready inputs)
 Model inference integration (how predictions are consumed by systems)
 Human‑in‑the‑loop controls (human validation or override of AI outputs)
 Ensure stories include AI‑relevant acceptance criteria, such as:
 Accuracy or quality thresholds
 Explainability requirements
 Monitoring and logging expectations
 Collaboration with Epic Owner & TPO (AI Alignment)

 (TPO = Technical Product Owner, responsible for technical coherence)

 Work closely with the Epic Owner and TPO to:
 Maximize business value from AI and data capabilities
 Align AI initiatives with strategic priorities at epic and feature level
 Co‑own business objectives, including AI‑enabled outcomes
 Refine Features into Product Backlog Items (PBIs) that reflect:
 Business intent
 Technical feasibility
 AI risk and compliance constraints


 Delivery Oversight & Risk Management (AI & Regulatory)
 Oversee delivery stages and ensure all risks are identified and mitigated, including:
 Regulatory risks (e.g. CSDR – Central Securities Depositories Regulation)
 Compliance and data protection (e.g. GDPR – General Data Protection Regulation)
 Security and architecture risks
 AI‑specific risks:
 Model bias
 Lack of explainability
 Data drift (changes in data patterns over time)
 Model drift (degradation of model performance in production)
 Ensure AI solutions comply with:
 Internal AI governance frameworks
 Model risk management expectations
 Audit and traceability requirements
 Sprint Execution & Value Validation
 Define with the squad:
 Sprint goals
 Sprint content
 Readiness of AI‑related work (data availability, environments, dependencies)
 Facilitate sprint reviews and demonstrations, ensuring:
 AI outcomes are explained in business terms
 Limitations and confidence levels are transparently communicated
 Validate and accept or reject delivered stories and features, including:
 Verification that AI outputs meet agreed acceptance criteria
 Confirmation that monitoring and controls are in place
 Measurement, KPIs & Continuous Improvement (AI‑Informed)
 Define and pilot Product and Business KPIs, with support from senior colleagues, including:
 Traditional KPIs (throughput, adoption, value delivered)
 AI‑specific indicators, such as:
 Prediction quality trends
 Automation rates vs. manual intervention
 Exception and override frequency
 Actively collect feedback from the squad and stakeholders and translate it into backlog improvements.
 Assess and demonstrate value delivered at squad level (e.g. squad health check boards), ensuring AI contributions are measurable and defensible.

 Role Scope & Support

 Operates on products of limited complexity, uncertainty, and dependencies, such as:
 Mature or end‑of‑life products
 Well‑defined operational scopes
 AI components with controlled impact and clear governance
 Receives guidance from senior colleagues for:
 Strategic decisions
 Complex prioritization trade‑offs
 AI‑related risk or compliance decisions

 Key Competencies (AI‑Infused)

 Strong Product Ownership fundamentals (Agile, backlog management, value prioritization)
 AI and data literacy, including:
 Understanding of the AI lifecycle (data → model → deployment → monitoring)
 Ability to translate business needs into AI‑ready requirements
 Awareness of AI governance, compliance, and ethical considerations
 Ability to collaborate effectively with:
 Data Scientists
 Machine Learning Engineers
 Architects and Risk/Compliance stakeholders

 Final Note (Positioning)

 This role does not require hands‑on model building , but it does require sufficient AI technology stack understanding to:

 Ask the right questions
 Prioritize the right work
 Ensure AI delivers real, compliant, and sustainable business value


 About Us

 Embark on your new adventure at Euroclear, and work at the heart of the global capital markets. We connect over 2,000 financial institutions across the globe. As an open and resilient infrastructure, we contribute to the stability of the financial markets. We help clients cut through complexity, lower costs, and mitigate risks of financial transactions.  What does this job entail?

 KBC is a digital frontrunner. Our data-driven strategy aims to provide our customers with the very best service. We treat our customers’ data respectfully, and we do this in line with all regulations concerning data and privacy protection. As a Compliance Advisor , you will contribute to this goal. Together with your colleagues in the team of Data & Consumer Protection & AI of Group Compliance , you will help KBC lead the way when it comes to data protection, in close cooperation with our internal business partners.

 What do we expect from you?

 You will monitor relevant legislation and new developments regarding the processing of personal data, privacy laws and the AI Act.
 You will advise on implementation within KBC and monitor compliance across KBC’s activities.
 You will advise on new products and activities from a data protection and AI perspective, including advising on the implementation of Data Protection Impact Assessments, Balancing Test, Transfer Impact Assessments, etc.
 You will support commercial line management in improving employee awareness and assist in the development of training programmes on data protection and AI.
 You will develop internal policies and revise them where necessary.
 You will help designing compliance processes and business processes when it comes to including compliance aspects. 
 You will manage small to medium-sized projects from the coordination of different tasks and people to the presentation of different results.


 Your key strengths?

 We’re looking for someone who identifies with the following behaviors:

 You take initiative and think along with your environment.
 You organize efficiently and maintain oversight.
 You communicate openly and in a connecting way.
 You enjoy collaboration and contribute to a positive team atmosphere.
 You thrive in a context of teams with different nationalities.
 You work discreetly and handle confidential information with care.
 You show resilience in stressful situations.
 You strive for the best possible result for the team in any context.


 What can we offer you?

 You have good knowledge of privacy regulations and have three to five years of practical experience in data and privacy protection. Experience in a customer-oriented/client-facing environment or domain, more specifically within the field of Compliance Data Protection, is an asset.
 You have at least basic knowledge of the AI act.
 You have a master's degree in a field such as law, economics or IT.
 You are highly driven and fully committed.
 You have experience in managing projects from start to end.
 You have strong critical thinking and analytical skills, you can think outside the box and you take a solution-oriented approach.
 You can communicate clearly in English, and either French or Dutch.
 You can be assertive when necessary and can persuade others in a diplomatic manner.
 You can unite and lead people to achieve a common goal.
 You think of solutions in terms of processes.

 Job Description

 Als toonaangevende telecomspeler, investeert Telenet volop in Data & AI om waarde te creëren voor onze klanten en onze business. Binnen de Data Acceleration Tribe zetten onze GenAI- en Predictive AI-clusters ambitie om in concrete actie, door Generative en Predictive AI opportuniteiten te vertalen naar producten en resultaten die schaalbaar en verantwoord uitgerold worden binnen de organisatie.

Om die ambitie verder te versnellen, zoeken we een AI Product Manager in onze GenAI Cluster: een AI Product Manager die werkt op het kruispunt van business, data, technology, governance en adoption. Je hoeft zelf geen modellen te bouwen, jouw impact ligt in het scherpstellen van de juiste problemen, het alignen van de juiste stakeholders, het bepalen van de juiste prioriteiten en het vooruitstuwen van AI-initiatieven met een duidelijke focus op value. Dit is een senior individual contributor rol: je leidt via expertise en invloed, niet via directe reports.

 Jouw rol als AI Product Manager

 Je brengt data en AI insights samen met concrete business actie door op te treden als bruggenbouwer tussen technische AI/data teams en business stakeholders. Je brengt structuur in ambiguïteit, bouwt en prioriteert een portfolio van high-value AI use cases en vertaalt complexe topics naar praktische next steps en heldere business recommendations, altijd met focus op impact en waarde creatie.

 Wat Zal Je Doen

 Je brengt structuur in ambiguïteit door complexe business uitdagingen te vertalen naar duidelijke AI-initiatieven, plannen, beslissingen en een geprioriteerde backlog van use cases.
 Je slaat de brug tussen inzichten en actie door analytics en GenAI/PredAI output te vertalen naar duidelijke, decision-oriented business recommendations en stakeholders te helpen impact en opportuniteiten te begrijpen.
 Je drijft value casing door sterke business en value cases op te bouwen, met focus op impact, prioritisatie, trade-offs, feasibility, risico’s, afhankelijkheden en expected return.
 Je zorgt voor stakeholder alignering door workshops en steering input te leiden, decision makers tot op senior niveau te beïnvloeden en iedereen mee te krijgen in de gekozen richting.
 Je bewaart het overzicht over delivery, dependencies, adoption en value realisation, en weet main points van details te onderscheiden.
 Je treedt op als champion van responsible AI door te werken binnen data & AI governance guardrails en manieren van werken te promoten die AI schaalbaar en verantwoordelijk maken binnen de organisatie.
 Je brengt het verhaal helder over door complexe topics begrijpelijk te maken met duidelijke boodschappen, aanbevelingen en visuals, afgestemd op elke doelgroep.


 Jouw profiel als AI Product Manager

 Je brengt structuur in complexe of ambigue topics via sterk strategisch en framework-based denken, en vertaalt dit naar een duidelijke richting en concrete aanpak.
 Je hebt een sterke affinity met data en AI, waardoor je kernconcepten rond data, analytics, machine learning en Generative AI begrijpt en de juiste vragen stelt terwijl je oplossingen kritisch kan scherper stellen.
 Je bent sterk in stakeholder management en influencing, waarbij je verwachtingen aligneerd, de juiste mensen connecteert en decision-making effectief vooruithelpt, ook op senior niveau.
 Je communiceert helder en impactvol via sterke storytelling, en past je boodschap vlot aan verschillende doelgroepen aan, zowel schriftelijk, visueel als in meetings.
 Je denkt in termen van business value en business cases, en houdt steeds focus op impact, value creation, prioritisatie en de juiste trade-offs.
 Je beschikt over sterke orchestration en projectmanagement skills, en zet ideeën om in concrete plannen, duidelijke ownership en meetbare vooruitgang.
 Je combineert relevante ervaring (in strategy, consulting, product management of data/AI rollen) met sterke leergierigheid, weerbaarheid in een snel-veranderende context, een servant leadership mindset, master-level thinking en een vlotte kennis van Engels (met Nederlands/Frans als sterke plus).


 Ons aanbod voor jou

 Bij Telenet group krijg je meer dan alleen een aantrekkelijk brutoloon. We geloven sterk in resultaten en ownership : we geven vertrouwen, maar verwachten ook engagement en impact. Wat jij realiseert, telt echt.

Naast een dertiende maand en vakantiegeld kan je rekenen op een uitgebreid pakket aan extralegale voordelen dat je ondersteunt in je dagelijkse leven én je werk.

 Wat mag je concreet verwachten?

 Mobiliteitsbudget: stel zelf je mobiliteitsplan samen, met keuze voor een bedrijfswagen of alternatieve vervoersoplossingen 
 Maaltijdcheques en ecocheques 
 Smartphone, mobiel abonnement, laptop en personeelskorting 
 Collectieve bonus en individuele bonus (afgestemd op jouw prestaties) 
 Hospitalisatieverzekering (inclusief ambulant plan) en groepsverzekering 
 20 wettelijke verlofdagen en 12 ADV-dagen 


 We vinden het belangrijk dat je je kan blijven ontwikkelen. Daarom investeren we in jouw groei via ons intern leerplatform , coaching en leren op de werkvloer. Je krijgt kansen om bij te leren en jezelf verder te versterken in je rol.

Samenwerken doen we het liefst van dichtbij. We geloven dat sterke teams ontstaan door elkaar regelmatig te zien en snel te kunnen schakelen. Daarom verwachten we dat je als nieuwe collega minimum drie dagen per week op kantoor werkt gedurende de eerste zes maanden. De overige dagen kan je van thuis werken. Na zes maanden wordt het aantal kantoorwerkdagen teruggebracht naar twee.

 Wat gebeurt er na je sollicitatie?

 Zie jij jezelf in deze rol? Dan kijken we uit naar je sollicitatie. We laten altijd iets van ons horen. Wanneer je wordt meegenomen in de eerste selectie, nemen we contact met je op om kennis te maken en lichten we de volgende stappen van ons selectieproces toe.

 Can’t wait to make an impact on the world? 

 You’re not alone. We strongly believe that data and the intelligent use of it hold a lot of potential for making an impact that matters to our clients, our people and society.

Join us in making this impact!

 Your journey with us 

 The AI&D team is looking for a (Senior) Consultant in Data & AI Governance to strengthen the team across the domains of Data Strategy, AI Strategy, Data Governance, AI Governance, and Master Data Management / ERP Data Governance. You will gain exposure to multiple industries and projects, working at the intersection of data, technology, and business strategy.

 Contribute to projects that span the full spectrum of data & AI strategy, data governance, AI governance and ERP/MDM governance.
 Support clients in defining and implementing operating models, frameworks, and governance processes to strengthen their data and AI foundations.
 Stay on top of emerging trends and advancements in AI & data governance and AI & data strategy, bringing thought leadership and innovative approaches.
 Advise clients on modernizing their data ecosystem—from platforms to data products and governance structures—while ensuring AI is embedded responsibly and ethically.
 Prepare and facilitate client workshops, interviews, and meetings.
 Build trusted relationships with clients and stakeholders across data and AI programs.
 Contribute to proposals and go-to-market activities across the AI & Data Strategy portfolio.
 Perform research and analysis on best practices in AI governance, data governance, and MDM/ERP governance, and translate findings into client recommendations.
 Deliver clear reports, conclusions, and roadmaps tailored to client needs.
 Conduct trainings and knowledge-sharing sessions for internal and external audiences.
 Support the further development of our AI & Data Strategy tribe.


 Let's Talk About You

 2–5 years of experience in data, AI, or digital transformation projects with exposure to one or more of the following: data governance, AI governance, data & AI strategy, and ERP/MDM governance.
 You hold a Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Computer sciences or related field
 Passionate about the role of data and AI in transforming organizations, with a curiosity for both strategic and operational aspects.
 Proven ability to work on multi-disciplinary projects involving data platforms, data & AI governance, AI ethics, and MDM or ERP transformations.
 Familiarity with data and AI governance frameworks, data and AI strategy practices, and ERP/MDM processes.
 Strategic mindset with the ability to translate business requirements into practical roadmaps and solutions.
 Experience with data or AI governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Atlan, MS Purview, SAP MDG, Responsible AI frameworks) is a plus.
 Strong communication skills; able to facilitate workshops, lead discussions, and engage stakeholders in diverse environments.
 Collaborative team player, self-starter, and eager to learn across multiple data & AI domains.
 Fluent in English with a very good level in Dutch.


 Our story

Technology does not stand still. It takes innovative approaches to transform, modernize, and run existing technology platforms. The key is knowing when to take advantage of the new technologies to drive product and service enhancements, improve financial performance, and accelerate speed to market.

When you harness the power of analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence (AI), you can uncover hidden relationships from vast amounts of data. Implementing the right strategy and technology will balance speed, cost, and quality to deliver measurable business value.

 Who is Deloitte?

 We provide industry-leading audit and assurance, tax and legal, consulting and related services. We are committed to driving innovation across offerings to help our clients address their challenges, while giving our professionals opportunities to learn and grow in this era of transformation.

ERA, marktleider in de Belgische vastgoedsector, zoekt een AI Strategist die ons helpt bepalen hoe we AI slim inzetten, niet als experiment, maar als hefboom voor onze organisatie en de 140+ ERA-kantoren die we ondersteunen.

 Company Description

 Sopra Steria offers tailored, end-to-end corporate technology and software solutions to help clients make bold choices and deliver results. Successfully so! With more than 51.000 colleagues in nearly 30 countries, we rank as Europe’s leading digital solutions provider. Some of the most successful companies in Europe rely on our technology due to our commitment to innovation, collaboration, and value in business development.

The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.

 Job Description

 Join our Data & AI team.

You will become part of a multidisciplinary team where data engineering, architecture, AI, analytics, governance and visualization come together. Together, we help clients get more value out of their data: from setting up the right data foundations to building dashboards, analytics solutions and AI use cases that support better decisions.

As a Data & AI Governance Consultant you play an active role in helping our clients implementat and operationalize their data & AI governance strategy. You support organizations in building a mature, data-driven culture and in translating the governance strategy into measurable objectives.

You participate in the design and continuous improvement of policies that enhance quality and completeness of data across the organization. This includes defining and implementing clear rules, standards and processes that ensure that data is managed and consumed responsibly and efficiently. You guide clients in creating an unambiguous conceptual framework and information model, laying out the foundation for reliable and trusted data use.

You will have the opportunity to define and implement governance processes tailored to each client’s maturity and needs, including data quality frameworks and stewardship models. Together with our existing team of data & AI governance experts, you keep our colleagues up to date with emerging market trends and best practices.

In addition to data governance, you take an active role in designing and implementing AI governance frameworks that ensure responsible, transparent, and safe use of AI across the organization, integrated with the data governance policies. Your guidance enables organizations to innovate confidently with AI while maintaining full oversight and compliance.

 Qualifications

 We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application!

 You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following:

 You have a minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience in data management and/or data governance. Experience in AI governance is a plus 
 You have excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, enabling you to navigate complex data challenges 
 Familiar with Data Management Fundamentals: data governance practices, business process modeling, data modeling and data architecture (e.g. DAMA DMBOK) 
 Knowledge of SQL-logic is a must 
 Knowledge of at least one of the data and AI management tools and technologies is a must: Collibra, Precisely, Informatica, Talend, MS Purview, IBM IGC 
 Knowledge of one of the following tools is preferred: Qlik, Tableau, Power BI 
 You are curious, proactive and an initiative taker and have a sharp understanding of how data can be used to drive a business 
 You have strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams 
 You have good oral and written communication skills towards both technical and non-technical stakeholders 
 You are proficient in English, knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a must 


 What We Can Offer You

 At Sopra Steria, you’ll join our Data Strategy & Governance Practice within the Data & AI team: a group of consultants helping organizations maximize the value of their data through clear strategy and strong data foundations.

We focus on delivering real business impact by identifying relevant use cases, supporting ideation and ensuring smooth, efficient data processes.

In parallel, we help build robust data governance frameworks by aligning people, processes and technology to create transparent and trusted data flows across the organization.

You’ll develop expertise in areas such as data cataloging (Collibra, Precisely), data quality, data modelling, data migration and unstructured data management—within a collaborative team that values knowledge sharing and continuous learning.

As part of Sopra Steria, you’ll also benefit from strong career development opportunities, both locally and internationally, supported by the Sopra Steria Academy and a wider network of more than 51.000 professionals.

 Additional Information

 Are you ready to further develop your career? Then we’d love to point you in the right direction. With offices in more than 30 countries, that direction might lead you to places you’ve never been to before. Would you prefer to grow internally? That’s possible, too. We challenge you to keep pushing yourself to become the best you can be.

 We offer a generous employee benefits package that includes: 

 A competitive salary and an indefinite contract
 A company car or mobility budget
 Comprehensive insurance coverage (hospitalisation, outpatient care and group insurance)
 32 days paid time off (20 days + 12 bonus days)
 Flexible, location-independent work
 Laptop, phone and mobile subscription
 Continuous learning opportunities through the Sopra Steria Academy to support your career development


 Ready to take the next step?

 We’re here to support you all the way and we are looking forward to your application!

______

 Sopra Steria is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to age, ancestry, nationality, color, family or medical leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, gender (including pregnancy), sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. We foster a work environment that is inclusive and respectful of all differences.

 In short: you make sure that once the technology is in place, people genuinely change how they   work   and the organisation sees the benefit.  


 What you will do  
 Lead adoption programmes for clients deploying Microsoft 365 Copilot, from planning through to measurable take-up.  
 
 Design and run change management approaches ;   communication, training, champion   networks   and follow-up . T ailored to each organisation.  
 
 Build and coach champion   communities and   deliver workshops and enablement sessions for end users and their managers.  
 
 Define adoption metrics and track them, using usage data to show progress and to adjust the approach where it is not working.  
 
 Translate adoption results into business terms, so that sponsors and leadership can see the return on their investment.

 For our Group Legal & Compliance department, we are looking for a Group Compliance Manager to support the business in navigating complex regulatory frameworks with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and a broader remit across key EU digital, information security, privacy, data and sustainability regulations .
 

 You will play a critical role in strengthening Dstny’s global compliance maturity , supporting its transition towards more complex customers and services, and ensuring readiness across a growing set of regulatory obligations identified in our Group Risk & Compliance (GRC) roadmap .
 

 Your key responsibilities will consist of: 
 

 1. AI product compliance & governance 
 Lead the implementation of the EU AI Act, identified as a top-priority regulatory topic for Dstny
 Translate AI regulatory requirements into practical governance frameworks, risk assessments and product requirements
 Develop and manage:
 AI risk classification methodologies
 AI product compliance documentation and audit readiness
 Vendor and subcontractor product compliance frameworks
 Support contractual negotiations involving AI-specific terms and annexes
 Ensure alignment between AI product compliance, product development and vendor ecosystem constraints
 

 2. Information security & resilience regulatory framework 
 Coordinate compliance efforts across key information security regulations and standards, including:
 EU NIS2 Directive
 EU DORA Regulation
 EU Cyber Resilience Act
 EU Cybersecurity Act
 National laws & regulations such as Germany’s BSIG / BSI-KritisV, UK’s Telecommunications Security Act and California’s CCPA where applicable
 Support certification and assurance programmes such as:
 ISO 9001 / ISO 27001 / ISO 27701 / ISAE3000 / SOC2 / BSI C5 / HDS / NEN7510
 

 3. Data, platform & digital regulation compliance 
 Lead or support compliance initiatives related to:
 EU Data Act & Data Governance Act
 EU Digital Services Act
 EU e-Evidence Regulation (cross-border data access obligations)
 Support the definition of:
 Data-sharing frameworks
 Platform governance and transparency obligations
 

 4. Accessibility, sustainability & ESG regulatory framework 
 Support compliance and reporting initiatives for:
 EU Accessibility Act
 EU CSRD
 EU CSDDD
 Broader ESG and sustainability frameworks (including SBTi)
 Work with finance, legal and business teams to:
 Implement ESG data collection and reporting processes
 Support due diligence on supply chains and human rights impacts
 

 5. Global compliance programme build-up 
 Build and scale a group-wide compliance operating model, aligned with Dstny’s GRC priorities
 Transition from a reactive (product) compliance approach to a structured, scalable framework, where compliance is embedded in the product lifecycle
 Improve, develop and implement policies:
 Create risk registers and prioritisation frameworks based on regulatory weight and maturity gaps
 Develop internal training & awareness programmes
 Set up and maintain a central compliance knowledge base
 

 

 7. Business partnership & strategic enablement 
 Act as a trusted advisor to product, engineering and business teams
 Support:
 Customer negotiations and tenders (particularly enterprise and service provider clients)
 Product roadmap decisions where compliance impacts go-to-market strategy
 Contribute to strategic discussions on AI and digital product offerings, ensuring regulatory readiness
 

 8. Vendor & supply chain compliance 
 Coordinate compliance obligations across subcontractors and vendors, including:
 Cascading regulatory requirements (AI, security, data, ESG)
 Contractual protections and audit rights
 Support procurement in managing third-party compliance risks across all relevant frameworks
 

 9. Stakeholder management & governance 
 Work closely with:
 Group Compliance Officer
 Group Information Security Officer
 Group Legal department
 Data Protection Officer
 Local Compliance Ambassadors
 Product, engineering, and procurement teams
 External advisors
 Represent Dstny in discussions with customers, regulators, authorities and partners on compliance matters
 

 Qualifications 
 5+ years of experience in regulatory, compliance, technology law, information security or risk management;
 Working knowledge of the following regulations is a plus:
 AI Act, NIS2, DORA and related frameworks
 Broader EU digital and ESG regulatory landscape
 Experience in SaaS or technology environments is strongly preferred;
 Ability to operate in a multi-jurisdictional and fast-evolving regulatory environment;
 Strong stakeholder management and communication skills;
 Pragmatic, structured and hands-on approach;
 Fluent in English (Dutch/French are a plus).
 

 What we can offer you... 
 A pivotal role in building and scaling Dstny’s Group-wide compliance framework across Europe and beyond.
 Direct exposure to cutting-edge topics such as AI regulation and digital resilience frameworks
 Close collaboration with senior leadership and key technical teams
 A competitive salary, including an eco-friendly company car with fuel/charging card or an interesting flexible mobility budget.
 Electronic meal vouchers, health insurance.
 Seniority days: extra vacation days based on your seniority (1 day every 3 years, up to a maximum of 4 days)
 Flex Income Plan: tailor extra advantages using your budget of your 13th month
 Access to Benefits@Work: enjoy discounts at a wide range of popular brands and retailers
 Flexible working hours, with the possibility of remote work. Because in digitalization, we should set a good example, right?

 A great team of colleagues and wonderful customers.
 A friendly atmosphere with regular fun team-building activities or company events.

 To be a part of the Dstny family: an ambitious, inclusive and people-centric organisation
