 relative overflow-hidden">
 Polysense is scaling fast. We're building operational intelligence software that's reshaping how food manufacturers work. Customers like Agristo, Lotus Biscoff, and La Lorraine are already running on it. As we grow, so do the expectations around how we handle data, infrastructure, and trust. Security and compliance are no longer nice to have. They're core to how we operate and how we sell.

To make that happen, we're hiring a Security Compliance Specialist . This is a zero-to-one role. You are the person who builds the security and compliance function at Polysense, sets the standards, and makes them stick. There is no existing team to inherit and no framework to maintain on someone else's behalf. You are starting something. Leadership will back you, engineering will partner with you, and sales will rely on you. The direction is yours to set, because no one has set it yet.

 The mission is to build a security and compliance foundation that Polysense's customers can trust, that holds up to external scrutiny, and that scales with a company that isn't slowing down.

 💼 What you’ll be doing 01. Information security frameworks

 Own ISO 27001 and SOC 2 from end to end. That means gap analysis, policy development, implementation, certification, and ongoing maintenance. You run the process and you keep it alive after the certificate is on the wall.
 Drive NIS2 and CRA compliance as they become increasingly relevant to our operating environment. Understand where Polysense sits in scope across both frameworks and make sure our obligations are documented and met.
 Develop and maintain the internal policy library: information security policies, access control, risk management, incident response, and everything in between. Policies don't write themselves and they don't stay accurate without someone owning them.
 Coordinate with external auditors and specialists during certification cycles. You prepare Polysense for those conversations and you manage the process through to completion.
 GDPR and data protection
 Own GDPR compliance at Polysense. From the register of processing activities to data protection impact assessments to vendor and sub-processor reviews, this is your domain.
 Be the internal reference point for anything data protection related. When the sales team has a question, when legal needs input, when a customer asks, the answer comes from you.
 Keep GDPR obligations up to date as the product evolves and as our customer base grows. Compliance is not a one-time project.
 Customer trust and internal audits
 Handle inbound customer security questionnaires. Our customers are large food manufacturers with their own compliance requirements, and they want to know Polysense takes this seriously. You make sure we can answer confidently and accurately.
 Run internal audits and manage the relationship with external penetration testing partners. You coordinate the work, own the findings, and track remediation.
 Build and own the incident response plan. If something goes wrong, we need to know exactly what to do, who does it, and how fast. That plan starts with you.



 Key point:

 You don't need deep offensive security skills. But you do need to understand how deep tech SaaS or HW/SW SaaS products are built, where they break, and how to close gaps before they become problems.

 💪 What You BringBackground & Experience

 Meaningful hands-on experience in a security, compliance or IT role with a clear focus on information security frameworks. You've done this before and you know what you're doing
 Solid working knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR and NIS2. You know these frameworks in practice, not just in theory
 A background in IT is important. You need to understand how systems are built to understand where they're exposed
 Familiarity with the tech stack of a deep tech SaaS or Hardware/Software SaaS company is a strong plus, close to a requirement. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to speak the language
 Experience with Azure, Azure DevOps or a compliance automation platform like Vanta is a strong plus
 Experience in a startup or scale-up is a genuine bonus. You know what it means to build without a playbook
 Exposure to the food manufacturing or food tech industry is a nice to have



 Mindset & way of working

 You own it fully



 You are the only security specialist at Polysense. No one will have the answers before you do. You set the direction, build the processes, and drive them forward without waiting to be asked

 Compliance enables, not blocks



 You understand that good security makes the business faster, not slower. You know how to build frameworks that hold up to scrutiny without creating unnecessary friction for the team.

 Clear communicator across the board



 You work with engineers, sales and leadership. You can translate technical compliance requirements into language that makes sense to all of them, and you bring people along with you.

 🌟 What Success Looks Like

 ✓ ISO 27001 certification is achieved and maintained through a clear, repeatable process you built and own

 ✓ SOC 2 compliance is structured, documented and progressing on a timeline you control

 ✓ GDPR, NIS2 and CRA obligations are up to date, owned and never a source of last-minute scrambling

 ✓ Customer security questionnaires are handled quickly, accurately and without pulling in half the company to answer them

 ✓ An incident response plan exists, is tested and the team knows how to use it

 ✓ Security is embedded in how Polysense builds and ships, not bolted on after the fact

 Context

 Degroof Petercam Internal Audit strengthens the Bank’s ability to create, protect and sustain value by providing independent, risk-based and objective assurance, advice, insight and foresight to management and governance bodies. It supports the identification, assessment and anticipation of risks and evaluates the effectiveness and efficiency of governance, risk management and internal control processes. The department is characterized by its independence, professional judgment, quality-oriented approach and commitment to continuous improvement.

 Degroof Petercam is part of Indosuez Wealth Management, the global wealth management brand of the Crédit Agricole Group . In this context, the Internal Audit function operates in a broader group environment, while remaining anchored in a Degroof Petercam internal audit team that interacts closely with the wider Indosuez internal audit community.. Audit assignments may therefore be performed both at Degroof Petercam and at Indosuez level, offering exposure to local entities, cross-border activities and group-wide governance, risk management and control topics.

We are looking to strenghten Degroof Petercam's Internal Audit Team with a Senior IT Auditor. 

 Your position

 You will lead the full audit mission lifecycle, delivering assurance while also providing insight on current risk and control issues and foresight on emerging risks and improvement opportunities:


  Identification, assessment and prioritisation of risks, including emerging and forward-looking risks, and clear understanding of the audit scope, objectives and key stakes

 Contribution to the overall diagnostic through data-driven analysis, professional judgment and interviews with auditees, with the aim of understanding root causes and business implications

 Definition of improvement areas and practical, risk-based recommendations that support stronger governance, risk management, controls, operational resilience and value creation

 Preparation of clear audit reports in English, presenting objective assurance conclusions as well as meaningful insights, trends, root causes and forward-looking considerations for management

 Participation in debriefings with auditees and constructive dialogue with stakeholders to support informed decisions, ownership of action plans and continuous improvement

 Performance of recommendations follow-up, including assessment of action plan effectiveness and identification of residual or evolving risks

 You will assist the Business Audit team by performing IT Audit controls in integrated missions and by bringing technology-related insight on digital, cyber, data, outsourcing and resilience risks.
 You will lead risk assessments to maintain a dynamic view of current and emerging risks, and you will contribute with the Head of Internal Audit to the definition of a risk-based and forward-looking IT audit plan.
 Following the IT Audit plan and the scope defined in the mission, some Business trips (less than 15%) can be required to other Indosuez entities (France, Monca, Switzerland, Luxembourg) 


 Your profile

 You have a master degree in IT or IT Auditing
 You have experience of at least 10 years in IT Audit (IT Internal Audit or external consultancy within Big4) and a good knowledge of audit procedures
 You have a certification such as CISA, CISSP, CIA,…
 You are familiar with universal frameworks such as COBIT Framework, ISO 27000, DORA and/or NIST
 You have good technical skills (experience with Python, AI, Cloud, IT security testing, Windows, AS400)
 You have experience in data analytics 
 You have an analytical and synthetic mindset, strong English writing skills, and the ability to translate complex findings into clear assurance conclusions, actionable insights and forward-looking messages for management
 You are sociable and have easy and excellent contact with people. You can work independently but are also a team player
 You are intellectually curious, forward-looking and a fast learner, with the ability to identify emerging risks, challenge constructively and propose pragmatic improvements
 You are fluent in French and English; knowledge of Dutch is an asset


 Our offer

 For more than 150 years, Degroof Petercam has been a reference investment house. Entrepreneurship is our DNA, expertise is our fuel. You will become part of a company with highly skilled, talented and passionate experts that aim for nothing less than excellence. The impact of our work goes beyond profit by looking at business from a broader perspective, challenging those who want to intellectually. As a part of Indosuez Wealth Management and Crédit Agricole, we offer our people ongoing learning and development and mobility on an international scale.

In addition to our fascinating work environment, we also offer:

 a dynamic work environment with experienced professionals
 an open company culture with a professional approach wherein quality is essential
 motivated and performing team members who receive responsibility
 continuous training and investment in your development, including opportunities to strengthen your leadership, stakeholder management and communication skills
 exposure to senior management and group-level audit topics, enabling you to develop both technical expertise and a broader understanding of the business

 What this role does not do

 Your profile

 A career ready to build

 What you'll be part of

At CCEP, technology and cyber security play a critical role in enabling our business, protecting our people, customers and consumers, and supporting our ambitious transformation agenda.

As Director, Cyber Security (CISO), you will lead the strategic direction, development and execution of our enterprise cyber security capability. Reporting to the VP, Service Delivery & Security, you will help shape how CCEP protects its technology landscape across IT, OT, cloud, applications and digital services while supporting innovation and business growth.

This is a highly visible leadership role where you will work closely with senior stakeholders across the organisation, providing expert guidance on cyber risk, resilience and security strategy. You will lead a team of security professionals and partner with colleagues across Business Process Technology (BPT) and the wider business to drive a secure-by-design culture and strengthen our overall cyber security posture.

If you are passionate about leading high-performing teams, influencing strategic decisions and staying ahead of an evolving threat landscape, this is an opportunity to make a significant impact at a European scale.

What you will do

As our Director, Cyber Security (CISO), you will:

Lead our cyber security strategy

 Define and deliver CCEP's cyber security strategy and roadmap, ensuring alignment with business priorities, technology transformation and emerging threats.
 Act as CCEP's designated Chief Information Security Officer, providing enterprise-wide leadership and expertise.
 Advise senior leaders on cyber risk, security investment priorities and strategic decision making.
 Develop and report meaningful security metrics, risk indicators and maturity measures to executive stakeholders.


 Strengthen cyber defence and resilience

 Lead our cyber defence capabilities, including monitoring, threat detection, incident response, crisis management and continuous improvement.
 Oversee Security Operations Centre capabilities, ensuring effective protection against evolving cyber threats.
 Lead executive cyber incident response activities during significant security events.
 Ensure security capabilities protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of business-critical services and information.


 Drive security architecture and engineering excellence

 Champion secure-by-design principles across technology initiatives and transformation programmes.
 Define the strategic direction for security architecture, engineering, application security and threat engineering.
 Oversee the effectiveness and continual optimisation of security platforms, controls and automation capabilities.
 Provide leadership on the secure adoption of emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions.
 Review and influence technology and solution designs to ensure security requirements are effectively addressed.


 Enhance governance and risk management

 Partner closely with Security Governance & Assurance teams to strengthen risk management, compliance and audit readiness.
 Support the ongoing effectiveness of security controls, including those supporting SOX and regulatory requirements.
 Ensure security requirements are embedded across supplier relationships, third-party services and managed service providers.
 Drive remediation of security risks, control gaps and audit findings.


 Lead people, partners and investment

 Build, inspire and develop a high-performing cyber security organisation.
 Create an environment of continuous learning, collaboration and technical excellence.
 Manage strategic relationships with security suppliers, partners and managed service providers.
 Oversee cyber security budget planning and investment decisions to maximise business value and risk reduction.
 Promote security awareness and a strong cyber security culture across CCEP.


 What we expect from you

 Experience And Qualifications

 You bring significant experience in cyber security leadership within complex, international organisations and have a proven track record of turning strategy into measurable outcomes.

You will have:

 Extensive experience in Cyber Security, Information Security, Technology Risk or related disciplines.
 Significant leadership experience in senior cyber security roles, ideally including CISO or Deputy CISO responsibilities.
 A degree in Information Technology, Cyber Security, Information Management, Business Administration or a related field.
 Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, ISO 27001, COBIT or equivalent.
 Experience leading security operations, engineering, architecture, application security, cloud security and operational technology security functions.
 Proven experience managing large-scale programmes, budgets, suppliers and strategic investments.
 Strong experience partnering with risk, audit, compliance, privacy and legal stakeholders.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.


 Technical expertise

You will demonstrate strong knowledge across:

 Enterprise cyber security strategy and operating models.
 Security architecture, Zero Trust and secure-by-design principles.

 You work closely with IT, OT, business leaders, the Data Protection Officer, security operations teams and the Information Security Forum to integrate security into key activities and create alignment across the organization.

 You communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and can clearly explain security risks, priorities and recommendations to senior management, directors and subsidiary leaders.
 Strong influencing, organizational and prioritization skills, allowing you to build consensus, challenge stakeholders when needed and drive security improvements across a complex organization.
 You hold a relevant master's degree or have acquired equivalent expertise through professional experience.
 Recognized certifications such as CISSP, CISM and ISO 27001 Lead Implementer are required. A good understanding of IT and OT environments, risk management and the energy sector is a strong asset. Fluent English and French are required.

 Build on existing governance, policies and roadmaps while further strengthening cybersecurity maturity across Luminus, its subsidiaries and affiliates. This is an opportunity to make a lasting impact without starting from scratch.

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 The Opportunity

 We have an opportunity for agile, market-savvy professionals in quantitative & financial risk and modelling. The focus of our team is on credit risk modelling, banking credit risk regulation, market risk modelling and (derivative) valuation, and derivatives instruments. We look to strengthen our team with Senior Consultants with a solid knowledge in one or more of these fields.

The Belgian Risk practice acts as a center of excellence within the EMEIA region with respect to quantitative modelling. Among others, this means we have a robust and broad expertise in the practical aspects of credit modelling. Together with our equally eminent colleagues of the Data & Analytics team, we also work on Machine Learning applied to credit risk as well as climate risk modelling for financial institutions as part of our sustainable finance workgroup.

On top of this continuous learning from local and international experts, we have developed an internal credit risk modelling program and an internal derivative valuation program. Both programs consist of a mix of face-to-face trainings, web-based learning and on-the-job training.

In Market Risk, we work on topics such as:

Capital Requirements Related (CRR):

 Regulatory topics: Fundamental Review of The Trading Book (FRTB), Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book (IRRBB) and underling models like pre-payment models
 Market Risk Modelling: Value at Risk Models, Expected Shortfall, Extreme Value Theory, Risk Factor Analysis
 Stress-Testing: Analysis and definition of stress-scenarios related to Market Risk Factors taking into account their statistical properties


 Derivatives Valuations:

Vanilla / complex derivatives (Multi-Asset / Path-Dependent / Skew Sensitive), credit and funding valuation adjustments, illiquid bond pricing. Also, prudent valuation is an important topic that is covered by the team.

The team also supports IFRS13 projects when it comes to the definition of Fair Value Levelling / Assessment of Observability of Input Parameters.

Aside of these purely technical areas, the team covers the review of Model Governance Frameworks as well, how institutions identify, monitor, measure and mitigate Model Risk, in particular for Pricing Models and Market Risk Capital Models.

 Key Responsibilities

 We are looking for a skilled quantitative professional, who may combine working on Belgian and European financial institutions. The ability to drive work forward to a conclusion, to find pragmatic solutions to complex problems and to explain and document them convincingly, are key factors in order to be successful in this role. Typical projects you will be involved in:

 Participate in, and lead Risk engagements, with the focus credit risk modeling, including the link with accounting (e.g. IFRS 9)
 You participate in engagements in the Risk practice, in the quantitative space, both from an advisory and an assurance perspective
 Support banks in preparing for regulatory reviews, or help them mitigate model weaknesses
 Assist banks in any stage of the model life cycle (developing new models, backtesting, independent validation of credit models, …)
 In the context of market risk and (derivative) valuation models typical tasks are:
 Develop and apply EY tools & models
 Participate to model development and model validation exercises
 Identify new areas for further development of EY tools & models, including the innovative application of machine learning in this application domain
 Assess the impact of climate risk and ESG considerations in general on market risk and (derivative) valuation model
 Explore and exploit the potential of alternative data and machine learning techniques to help financial institutions bring their credit modelling to the next level
 Investigate the impact of climate risk and ESG aspects in general on credit risk
 Contribute to the standardization and automation of the model development and model validation process
 Understand our full range of service offerings and actively identify and develop new opportunities to address emerging client needs
 You coordinate the workload in various projects, and develop productive working relationships with internal and external clients
 You prepare concise, complete and convincing reports on the work done, and present it to more senior colleagues and clients
 You act as a team member, coaching and supervising junior staff, seeking guidance from senior colleagues as needed, and keeping everybody informed on the progress of the assignment.


 Skills And Attributes For Success

 Master’s degree in Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering or a relevant quantitative field
 Between 2-5 years of relevant professional experience
 Solid understanding of quantitative modeling techniques and practical experience with valuation of complex instruments (e.g. derivative, illiquid bonds) and/or market risk (e.g. FRTB, IRRBB, VAR models) is mandatory
 Deep understanding of quantitative modeling techniques, with practical experience in credit risk (IRB, IFRS9) and practical experience with derivative pricing in one or more asset classes (FX, rates, equity, …)
 Experience with building (risk) reports and experience with communication around (mathematical) complex issues at management level is a major plus
 Knowledge of some key vendor packages, and some frequently used programming languages (R, Matlab, C++, Python, SAS) in the risk and/or valuation domain is mandatory
 Strong interest in or some initial experience with machine learning algorithms
 Proficient level of business English and good communication skills; knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a major asset
 Team spirit, but self-sufficient and autonomous
 Pragmatic approach, with the ability to self-motivate and inspire the members of a team
 Eagerness to learn more about the Financial Services market in Belgium and Europe.


 What Working At EY Offers

 You will be part of a leading global professional services firm.
 You will be part of the EY family where everyone is willing to offer support and senior management is very accessible. 
 You will join a dynamic and growing team with a great mix of young and experienced professionals focusing on financial services.
 You will get extensive trainings on technical matters, as well as soft skills and project management, and you will have access to new technologies and innovative equipment.
 We are proud of our flexible working arrangements, and we will support you to build a successful career and deliver excellent client service, without sacrificing your personal priorities.
 While our client-facing profession might require part-time working at client site and business traveling at times, we are committed to helping you achieve a lifestyle balance.


 At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

 EY | Building a better working world 

 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

 Job Description & Summary


 Contribute to creating a better tomorrow

 The Financial Services Risk and Regulatory team at PwC advises leading financial services organisations on a wide variety of risk and capital management issues. These range from the implementation of new regulatory requirements, such as Basel reform and IFRS 9, and the remediation following supervisory inspections, to defining and setting risk appetite and improving risk management throughout the organisation. 

 We have significant growth plans and are looking for ambitious and dedicated professional advisors in the area of credit risk quantification: capital requirement calculation, IRB modelling, credit VaR, credit pricing, business modelling including early warning systems, collection models etc.

 We’re looking for a talented Credit Risk (Senior) Manager to join our Financial Services department as part of our Credit Risk team.

 Bring your talent. Learn new skills. Make a positive impact.

 As a Credit Risk Professiona l, you have a strong transversal view on the risk areas and are able to connect quantitative capabilities, regulatory requirements, accounting standards and risk framework. 

 On a weekly basis, you will support in many areas:

 Strengthen client relationships through tailor made professional services for our clients and develop new business networks.
 
 Prepare and present proposals to clients for end-to-end solutions.
 
 Keep track of new regulations and their impact on our clients and the market.
 
 Work closely with your colleagues in other areas of advisory especially in delivering cross-functional projects.
 
 Provide consultancy on regulatory developments and/or credit risk modelling; TRIM remediations, credit risk modelling, validation and model audit.
 
 Involvement in non-regulatory modeling projects to support the credit business of our clients, this includes but not limited to pricing, profitability, early warning, fraud and/or collection models.

 
 About you 

 You graduated from quantitative departments such as economics, statistics or engineering. Holding a Master’s degree or PhD in economics, statistics, quantitative finance, mathematical or engineering discipline and a strong interest or qualification in credit risk management is a plus. 

 In addition you are expected to have: 

 A professional experience of 4 to 8 years in credit risk departments of banks in regulatory models (development and/or validation of PD, LGD and EAD models).
 
 Knowledge of a risk management framework (risk appetite framework, risk identification, risk measurement and risk mitigation), Basel Accord and recent developments (Basel IV) and general credit risk related regulatory requirements (CRR/CRD IV and IFRS 9 requirements).
 
 Knowledge of credit risk quantification: capital requirement calculation, IRB modelling, credit VaR, credit pricing, business modelling including early warning systems, collection models etc
 
 Good knowledge of programming languages such as Python, R or SAS.
 
 Knowledge of non-regulatory models is a plus.
 
 You are fluent in Dutch and/or French , with full professional proficiency in English .

 
 Life at PwC Belgium

 Flexibility:   flexible working hours so you can decide your most effective working pattern.

li-4428083284.description:
show-more-less-html__markup--clamp-after-5

 Omschrijving

 Je staat in voor de ontwikkeling, het onderhoud, en vaak ook de implementatie en/of het gebruik van financiële modellen die dienen om de risico's, die de bank loopt, te kwantificeren.. Je draagt bij tot een goede risico inschatting vooraf, en correcte voorstelling van de gelopen risico's aan management en regulator.

 De job in een notendop

 Binnen de afdeling Strategic Risk Management & Modelling (directie CRO) is het team verantwoordelijk voor het kwantificeren van de diverse risico’s die de bank neemt: het kredietrisico (IRB-risicoparameters, krediet economisch kapitaal/ECAP), provisionering (IFRS9), ALM-risico’s (voorafbetaling, rentevoet), niet-financiële risico’s (ESG, operationeel risico) en algemene risico’s (stresstesting).

Het team ondersteunt ook andere risicobeheersafdelingen bij het uitwerken stand brengen van kwantitatieve tools ter ondersteuning van het beslissingsproces (bv. goedkeuring van kredieten of early warning-systemen).Het team is belast met het globaal beheer van de modellen en begeleidt hen doorheen hun hele levenscyclus: ontwikkeling en verbetering van modellen, ondersteuning van de implementatie, geregeld testen en onderhoud. Het team interageert actief met de teams Credit Risk Management en Strategic Risk Management om te zorgen voor het afdoend kwantificeren van de risico’s en het aangepast integreren van de modellen in de risk- en de businessprocessen.

Gezien het belang voor de bank van een goed risk management in het algemeen, en de rol van modellen die daarbij gebruikt worden, komt het team frequent in contact met het centrale management van de bank en met de regulator.

 Jij hoeft geen witte raaf te zijn

 Al kan je er bij ons wel één worden. We zoeken vooral een straffe persoonlijkheid met een learning mindset.

Bij ons mag je volop je vleugels uitslaan als je je herkent in de volgende eigenschappen:

 De ideale kandidaat is nieuwsgierig en analytisch ingesteld en heeft een natuurlijke gedrevenheid om het beter te doen dan de onmiddellijke vereisten van het project en om hindernissen te overwinnen.
 Je beschikt over een master in een wetenschappelijk domein zoals wiskunde, fysica, engineering, handelsingenieur.
 Je beschikt over uitgesproken kennis van wiskunde en statistiek en over degelijke vaardigheden op het vlak van data mining en data-analyse.
 Je beschikt over IT-/programmeervaardigheden met bij voorkeur Python (maar ook Java of C++, Visual Basics) en technische data management-vaardigheden met bij voorkeur SQL (maar ook Oracle, Access).
 Eerdere ervaring inzake Financiën/Verzekeringen en gevorderd statistiek, econometrie en in stochastische modelvorming of kredietrisicomodelvorming is een pluspunt.
 Je bent oplossingsgericht en kan theoretische vereisten omzetten in pragmatische technische oplossingen.
 Je bent in staat zelfstandig te werken en initiatief te nemen, en je bent ook bereid om je in te passen in een team en in een groter project.
 Je bent in staat helder te communiceren over ingewikkelde onderwerpen.Je bent in staat vlot te communiceren (zowel mondeling als schriftelijk) in het Engels, alsook in het Nederlands en/of het Frans (als werktaal).
 Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring met (een deel van) de topics die in het team behandeld worden en met de technieken die in het team gebruikt worden. Je bent in staat complexe projecten te managen. 



 Belfius koestert zijn talenten

 Behalve de kans om elke dag te shinen, bieden wij jou een fulltime contract van onbepaalde duur met:

 Een mooi loon aangevuld met een innovatief aanbod om een persoonlijk budget samen te stellen dat je kan besteden volgens je voorkeuren (bv. wagen, fiets, pc, smartphone, tablet, huisvesting onder bepaalde voorwaarden) en extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, personeelsvoordeel op eigen producten en diensten, en een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering.
 Mogelijkheden te over om je te ontwikkelen door een brede waaier aan opleidingen en carrièrekansen in de hele Belfius-groep.
 Een goede werk-privé balans dankzij flexibele uren, de combinatie kantoor- en thuiswerk en een aantrekkelijk aantal vakantiedagen.
 Een moderne werkplek in het hart van Brussel met een coole fitness, een lekker gezond restaurant en gezellige ontmoetingsruimtes, dit alles op wandelafstand van de winkelstraat, het treinstation Brussel-Noord en de metrohalte Rogier.

In een multidisciplinair team bouw je mee aan robuuste modellen die essentieel zijn voor strategische beslissingen. Je impact is concreet en zichtbaar in cruciale berekeningen en inzichten. Je krijgt de ruimte om expertise te verdiepen en mee richting te geven aan het risicobeheer. 
 Jouw uitdagingen
 
 Beheren en continu verbeteren van modellen voor projectie van passiva in Non-Life en Gezondheid. 
 Uitwerken van conceptuele verbeteringen van modelleringstools en methodologieën. 
 Uitvoeren van gerichte analyses in functie van business- en marktontwikkelingen. 
 Valideren en uitvoeren van berekeningen voor Solvency II en IFRS. 
 Bijdragen aan afsluitingsprocessen en stresstests. 
 Ondersteunen bij de uitwerking en evaluatie van expert judgments.

 Goed begrip van het regelgevend kader en de vertaling naar modellen.

 Je werkt graag samen en neemt verantwoordelijkheid op.

 Actieve bijdrage aan een lerende organisatie. 
 Sterke impact op beslissingen en strategische richting.

li-4426868701.description:
show-more-less-html__markup--clamp-after-5
 relative overflow-hidden">
 Description

 Vous assurez le développement, la maintenance, et souvent aussi l’implémentation et/ou l’utilisation de modèles financiers qui servent à quantifier les risques pour la banque. Vous contribuez ainsi à la bonne compréhension ex-ante et représentation ex-post des risques au management et instances prudentielles.

 Votre job en deux mots

 Au sein du département Strategic Risk Management & Modelling (direction du CRO), l’équipe se charge de la quantification des différents risques pris par la banque: risque de crédit (paramètres de risque IRB, capital économique/ECap de crédit), provisionnement (IFRS9), risques LBC (remboursement anticipé, taux d’intérêt), risques non financiers (ESG, risque opérationnel) et risque global (stress tests).

Aussi, l’équipe soutient d’autres départements de gestion des risques dans la mise en place d’outils quantitatifs d’aide à la décision (par exemple, systèmes d’approbation de crédit ou d’alerte précoce). Chargée de la gestion globale des modèles, l’équipe suit ceux-ci tout au long de leur cycle de vie : développement et amélioration du modèle, soutien à la mise en œuvre, tests réguliers et maintenance. L’équipe interagit activement avec les équipes Credit Risk Management et Strategic Risk Management afin de garantir une quantification adéquate des risques et une intégration appropriée des modèles dans les processus de risque et les processus opérationnels.

Etant donné l’importance pour la banque d’une gestion de risques adéquate, et du rôle des modèles dans ce cadre, l’équipe est en contact avec le management de la banque et le régulateur.

 Pas besoin d’être un oiseau rare

 Mais vous pouvez en devenir un, parmi nous. Nous cherchons surtout une forte personnalité avec un learning mindset.

Chez nous, vous pourrez déployer pleinement vos ailes si :

 Le candidat idéal sera doté d’un esprit critique et d’analyse, doublé d’une volonté naturelle de dépasser les besoins immédiats du projet et de surmonter les obstacles.
 Vous êtes titulaire d’un master dans un domaine scientifique tel que les mathématiques, la physique, l’ingénierie, etc. 
 Vous avez de fortes aptitudes en mathématiques et en statistiques et de solides compétences en matière d’exploration et d’analyse des données. 
 Vous avez des compétences en informatique / programmation, de préférence Python (mais aussi Java ou C++, Visual Basics) et des compétences techniques en gestion de données, de préférence SQL (mais aussi Oracle, Access). 
 Toute expérience préalable dans le domaine de la finance et/ou de l’assurance et en statistiques avancées, en économétrie et modélisation stochastique ou en modélisation du risque de crédit est un atout.
 Vous êtes orienté vers les solutions et êtes à même de traduire des exigences théoriques en solutions techniques pragmatiques. 
 Vous êtes capable de travailler de manière indépendante et de prendre des initiatives, tout en étant disposé à intégrer une équipe et un projet plus vaste. 
 Vous avez la capacité à communiquer clairement sur des sujets complexes. Vous savez vous exprimer couramment (à l’oral et à l’écrit) en anglais, ainsi qu’en néerlandais et/ou en français (langue de travail).
 Vous avez plusieurs années d'expérience avec (une partie des) sujets abordés dans l'équipe et avec les techniques utilisées dans l'équipe. Vous êtes capable de gérer des projets complexes. 



 Belfius prend soin de ses talents

 Outre la possibilité de faire votre chemin dans un job qui vous plaît, nous vous offrons un contrat à temps plein à durée indéterminée avec :

 Un salaire attractif complété par une offre innovante vous octroyant un budget à utiliser selon vos préférences personnelles (p. ex. voiture, vélo, PC, smartphone, tablette, loyer ou crédit hypothécaire sous certaines conditions) et des avantages extralégaux, tels que des chèques-repas, des avantages sur les produits et services internes, une assurance hospitalisation et une assurance groupe.
 Des possibilités de développement par le biais d'un large éventail de formations et des opportunités de carrière dans l’ensemble du groupe Belfius.
 Un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à des horaires flexibles, à la combinaison du travail au bureau et à domicile et un nombre attractif de jours de congé.
 Un lieu de travail moderne au cœur de Bruxelles, avec une salle de sport branchée, un délicieux restaurant sain et des espaces de réunion confortables, le tout à quelques pas de la rue commerciale, de la gare Bruxelles-Nord et de la station métro Rogier.

li-4426516338.description:
show-more-less-html__markup--clamp-after-5
 relative overflow-hidden">
 Wat houdt deze vacature in?

Het RWA Strategy & Regulatory Reporting-team speelt een centrale rol in het waarborgen van de kapitaalsterkte en de naleving van de regelgeving van de bank. We vertalen regelgeving naar strategische inzichten, beheren het volledige RWA‑raamwerk end‑to‑end en leveren hoogwaardige rapportering aan interne en externe stakeholders.

Aangezien stresstests een belangrijke pijler worden binnen kapitaalplanning, portefeuillebewaking en klimaatrisicobeheer, versterken we onze capaciteiten met een toegewijde Stress Testing Expert . Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s binnen Risk, Group Reporting Solutions, Finance, Modelling en Regulatory Reporting binnen alle KBC-entiteiten — inclusief onze Centraal-Europese vestigingen.

Als Stress Testing Expert draag je bij aan de groepsbrede beoordeling van de veerkracht van de bank onder ongunstige economische, geopolitieke en klimaatgerelateerde scenario’s. Je ontwikkelt stresstestmethodologieën, voert stresstestoefeningen uit, analyseert portefeuillegevoeligheden en vertaalt de resultaten naar duidelijke en betekenisvolle inzichten voor senior management en toezichthouders.

Je werk ondersteunt rechtstreeks strategische besluitvorming, kapitaalplanning en het bredere RWA‑beheerprogramma van KBC.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

 Deelnemen aan volledige end‑to‑end groepsbrede stresstestoefeningen, inclusief EBA/ECB‑stresstests en interne ICAAP‑gerelateerde analyses.
 Negatieve economische en klimaatscenario’s toepassen op relevante krediet- en RWA‑portefeuilles, en de impact op voorzieningen, kapitaalbehoeften en risico-indicatoren kwantificeren.
 Macro-economische, geopolitieke en klimaatgerelateerde gebeurtenissen (bv. crisissituaties, energieschokken) vertalen naar stressscenario’s voor portefeuilles.
 Het stresstestramwerk verbeteren door opportuniteiten te identificeren inzake datakwaliteit, modelleringsaanpakken en procesefficiëntie.
 Optreden als inhoudelijk expert op het vlak van stresstests binnen het RWA Strategy & Regulatory Reporting-team.


 Jouw troeven? 

 Je combineert een bachelor- of masterdiploma (bv. economie, (ingenieurs-)wetenschappen, technologie of wiskunde) met ervaring in Credit Risk
 Een kwantitatieve achtergrond en/of ervaring met het verwerken van grote datasets is een troef.
 Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden (mondeling en schriftelijk), met het vermogen om technische concepten helder uit te leggen.
 Affiniteit met kwantitatieve methodes en bereidheid om met geavanceerde analyses te werken.
 Sterke Excel-vaardigheden en bereidheid om met Python of andere analysetools te werken.
 Vermogen om zelfstandig te werken en kwalitatieve output te leveren binnen deadlines.
 Flexibele mindset en comfortabel werken in een team van ongeveer 10–15 experts.
 Vloeiend in het Engels.
 Kan je ook (één van) deze puntjes afvinken? Nog beter!
 Ervaring met stress testing, risicomodellering, kapitaalmetrics, interpretatie van prudentiële regelgeving (CRR/CRD, EBA-richtlijnen, ICAAP/ILAAP) of regulatory reporting is een plus.
 Kennis van Python, SQL, SAS of andere analysetools.

 Wat hebben we je te bieden?

 Bij ons ben je zeker van een uitstekende onboarding, collegialiteit en een aangename werksfeer. Je collega’s helpen je om een vlotte start te nemen in de job en te groeien in je expertise.
 Doorheen je hele loopbaan bij KBC moedigen we je aan om verder te groeien als persoon en als professional. Je kan opleidingen volgen waarin je je hard en soft skills verder aanscherpt.
 Je kan tot 50% per maand telewerken. Tegelijk hechten we veel belang aan een goede groepssfeer. Daarom werk je minstens twee dagen per week op dezelfde fysieke locatie als je directe collega’s.
 Flexibele werkuren helpen je om je werk en je privéleven op elkaar af te stemmen.
 We bieden jou een contract van onbepaalde duur en een competitief loon aangevuld met extralegale voordelen. Sounds familiar? Tuurlijk, dit lees je in elke vacature. KBC maakt het verschil met een uitgebreid flexpakket. Te uitgebreid om hier uit de doeken te doen. De verschillende voordelen - groot en klein - bespreken we graag met jou tijdens je sollicitatiegesprek.

 Market Risk Analyst (F/M/X) 

 Do you combine a good u nderstanding of commodity markets with knowledge of risk management principles and methodologies? Do you like to use your strong analytical skills to dig for root causes and challenge your stakeholders to manage market risks ?

Then this job is for YOU!

For the EGM Market Risk team we are currently looking for a Market Risk Analyst (F/M/X) based in Brussels . 

 YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES As Market Risk Analyst

 Ensure that all trading activities are in line with the market risk requirements of the EGM & S&EM Risk Policy and the approved limits framework by s etting and enforcing market risk limits, reporting and analysing Market risk , tailoring globally consistent monitoring and control processes to suit local requirements and by analysing the market, liquidity, model, and physical risks 
 Calibrate, monitor and control Local and Global Risk Mandates for new and existing activities 
 challenge of Front Office hedging strategies in a proactive and constructive way ensuring we reach an optimal risk/reward ratio in line with risk appetite; 
 Assess the risk for new transactions / products requiring specific market risk validation 
 Maintain and improve Market Risk tools and reporting templates; 
 Cooperate closely with different stakeholders to ensure coherent implementation of the global market risk framework. 


 YOUR PROFILE as Market Risk Analyst 

 You hold a Master or MBA and have obtained some relevant work experience in energy and commodities trading 
 Demonstrated coding skills with Python; 
 Understanding of commodity markets, instruments, products to assess their impact on market risk indicators. 
 Knowledge of risk management principles, methodologies, and best practices; 
 Strong analytical and investigative mindset with the ability to challenge assumptions and identify root causes; 
 High level of integrity for work output and able to manage conflicting demands. 
 You are able to communicate orally and in writing about complex risk concepts and findings to stakeholders at all levels of the organization; 
 You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills to analyze data, identify trends, and make informed decisions about market risk exposures; 
 You are a collaborative teamplayer 


 Research shows that men apply when they meet 60% of the requirements while women only apply when they are convinced they meet 100%. Don’t let that hold you back – we’d love to hear from you!

 ENGIE Supply & Energy Management (S&EM) provides energy supply solutions and risk management services to support its clients through their decarbonization journey, while optimizing ENGIE’s assets and contributing to value creation.

ENGIE is a global reference in low-carbon energy and services with a leading energy management business, piloted by its entity " Supply & Energy Management " who built its savoir-faire managing the Group’s large and diverse asset portfolio over 20+ years.

3,600 employees around the world develop our solutions, through +20 international business pla tforms. We cover the full energy mix: renewable and thermal power, natural gas & LNG, biomass, environmental products.

Our experts provide tailor made solutions based on a wide range of savoir-faire in energy management with a strong focus on decarbonation and decentralization.

Our 190,000 clients span the entire value chain: producers, asset develope rs, financial players, utilities, distributors and industrials. Our global reach and strong

local presence enable us to offer these diverse clients tailor-made services and respond to rapid changes in mature or emerging markets alike.

Our 4 expertise domains are Asset management, Energy transition services, Energy supply & global commodities and Risk management & market access

At S&EM we encourage breakthrough results, team spirit, curiosity and innovation while preserving the right work/life balance for you.

More info on S&EM Hub (https://gems.engie.com) or LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/engie-global-energy-management-solutions).

 Your job in a nutshell 
 Are you a data-savvy professional, passionate about turning raw data into actionable insights?
 As an Internal Auditor - Data Analyst in the Internal Credit Models Audit Team of Inspection Générale (IG) Hub Brussels, Factor you will play a crucial role in supporting management and audit teams by participating in audit missions with a focus on data mining and analysis. You will contribute to credit models deep-dive assignments through data analytics and help evaluate the effectiveness of governance, risk management and control processes.
 This is a role for a practical, hands-on data professional who enjoys ensuring processes run reliably as much as building new solutions.
 

 And in detail 
 You analyze and document business processes, leveraging on the use of related business and credit models data, and contribute to their continuous improvement;
 You support the audit teams to translate audit objectives into data requirements, and to extract data from data warehouses and operational systems, transforming data and preparing it for analysis in the context of credit model reviews and deep-dive audit work.
 You provide meaningful data insights, through advanced data mining and analytics, ensuring data is fit for purpose for audit and deep-dive review activities.
 You develop, enhance and maintain solutions using the Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate), SAS and Python to support audit analytics and the review of internal credit models.
 

 Your skills and strengths 
 You have a strong analytical mindset.
 You have a proven experience, or a strong academic background, in data analytics or data engineering, ideally complemented by exposure to model development, model validation or related audit work.
 You are interested in learning the bank’s data platforms and you have strong hands-on experience with data tools, enabling you to work effectively on datasets used in model analysis and audit testing.
 You have a solid understanding of data governance, quality, and security management principles.
 You have a strong expertise in the use of Microsoft Power Platforms: Power BI (data modelling, DAX, dashboard development), Power Automate (workflow automation), PowerApps (basic application development and support).
 Experience with Python, BI4 and SAS for data transformation and analysis is a strong plus, particularly for audit analytics and model-related data investigations.
 

 Furthermore 
 You can use English as a working language for both verbal and written communication. Additionally, you are fluent in one of our national languages (French or Dutch) and have a very good knowledge of the other.
 You have a master's degree.
 You have strong problem-solving skills, and you pay attention to details.
 You work autonomously, manage priorities and respect deadlines.
 You have excellent organizational skills, and you are able to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
 You proactively and enthusiastically contribute as a team player with a professional, result-driven, and client-oriented approach.
 You are entrepreneurial and continuously seek improvement.
 

 What can we offer you? 
 A permanent contract and an attractive remuneration package.
 In addition to your remuneration and benefits (meal vouchers, insurance, Bank holidays), we offer flexible salary options, allowing you to convert part of your salary into personalized benefits (phone use, IT equipment, transport, etc.).
 

 Our impact 
 As a company, we implement concrete and sustainable solutions to reduce our environmental footprint, such as saving paper and resources, recycling our waste, encouraging the use of green transport, occupying buildings that are designed and managed to limit our impact, etc.
 Your prospects 
 We offer a wide range of training courses, workshops and webinars to choose from depending on your availability, interests and goals.
 Let's share our values: 
 At BNP Paribas Fortis, we surround ourselves with talented people, regardless of their gender or gender identity, their age, their origin, their sexual orientation, their disability... And to guarantee equal opportunities for everyone, whatever their personal or family commitments, our full-time job offers are also open to part-time employees, at 80% or 90%.
 

 Ready to seize this opportunity? 
 We will make an initial selection based on your CV and cover letter. We will contact you if your profile matches our vacancy.

 Job #: req37664

Organization: World Bank

Sector: Disaster Risk Management

Grade: EC2

Term Duration: 1 year 0 months

Recruitment Type: Local Recruitment

Location: Brussels,Belgium

Required Language(s): English

Preferred Language(s): French, Spanish or Portuguese

Closing Date: 8/11/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC

 Description

 Do you want to build a career that is truly worthwhile? Working at the World Bank provides a unique opportunity for you to help our clients solve their greatest development challenges. The World Bank consists of two entities – the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) and the International Development Association (IDA). It is a global development cooperative owned by 189 member countries. As the largest development bank in the world, the World Bank provides loans, guarantees, risk management products, and advisory services to middle-income and creditworthy low-income countries, and coordinates responses to regional and global challenges. For more information, please visit www.worldbank.org .

 Infrastructure Vice Presidency 

 Globally, one billion people live more than 2 kilometers from all-weather roads, 685 million people lack electricity, and nearly 4 billion people lack internet access. Access to basic infrastructure services is critical for creating economic opportunities for the poor. The Infrastructure (INF) Vice Presidency within the World Bank is charged with developing sustainable solutions to help close infrastructure gaps in developing and emerging economies. It consists of four global departments: Energy & Extractives (EEX); Transport (TRA); Resilient Tourism; Urban, Resilience and Land (URL), and Global Infrastructure Finance Department. It oversees the Bank's work across energy and transport sectors, urban development, as well as efforts to promote energy transition, low-carbon transportation, livable cities, disaster risk resilience, land management, and quality infrastructure services through public-private partnerships. Infrastructure represents around $110 billion of the Bank’s portfolio. For more information: https://www.worldbank.org/en/topic/infrastructure

The Global Knowledge Unit for Disaster Management, Solutions & Impact (KIUSD) supports low and middle-income countries to understand, manage, and reduce their risks from natural hazards and climate change. Within KIUSD, the Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery (GFDRR) umbrella trust fund is a global partnership that helps low- and middle-income countries better understand and reduce their vulnerability to natural hazards and climate change. KIUSD has 14 Global Thematic Areas, which provide grant financing, analytics, and technical assistance to the most vulnerable countries and communities where it will have the greatest positive impact. As a donor-funded program, GFDRR consults regularly with donors and actively strives to maintain and develop new partnerships for increased impact. For more information: https://www.gfdrr.org/en

Please note this position is financed by a Trust Fund and renewal is contingent upon availability of funding, in addition to other factors, including but not limited to business needs, staff performance and skills fit.

 Job Duties And Responsibilities

 KIUSD is seeking a qualified and motivated professional to form a critical part of the disaster risk analytical work and contribute to teams within the unit and beyond, for the implementation of activities under the Disaster Risk Analytics thematic area.

Tasks Include Providing Expert Technical Inputs And Operational Expert Support On Disaster Risk Analytics To Task Teams And World Bank Clients (advice On Technical Studies For Project Design And Implementation, Post Disaster Damage Assessments, Developing Disaster Risk Financing Strategies, Joining Field Missions And Virtual Meetings With Client Governments). The E T Consultant Will Work The Disaster Risk Analytics Team And Will Be Expected To Contribute Or Lead Knowledge Products Related To Risk Analytics, And Climate And Disaster Risk Management Under Other KIUSD Global Technical Thematic Areas. The E T Consultant Will Work Closely With The Task Team Leaders And Core Staff Of The Global Knowledge Unit For Disaster Management, Solutions & Impact (KIUSD) Under Managerial Supervision Of The Practice Manager Of KIUSD

 Under the supervision of the TTL, support the development and implementation of flood risk analytics that input into post-disaster damage tools and applications including Global Rapid post-disaster Damage Estimation (GRADE) remote assessments.
 Engage with regional TTLs and government counterparts on the risk analytics methodologies and results.
 Develop the risk analytics capabilities with the TTL and team through the development and improvement of flood risk modelling products, innovations, coding, and tools to support Bank operations and client engagements.
 Support the implementation and procurement of flood and climate related risk reduction, preparedness and climate adaptation technical activities to be carried out by client or other experts and ensure integration of disaster risks management into broader multi-hazard risk reduction strategies and response plans.
 Where necessary, discuss and define with the task teams the technical requirements for activities in Flood Risk Management Technical Assistance, and identify terms of reference, international experts or institutions that can support the activity.
 Cultivate and advance partnerships with firms, consultants, external institutions, and internal World Bank teams for the co-development of new products, support to operational Task Teams, and advancement of the field of flood risk management.
 Illustrate Program advancements and contributions in the form of blogs, peer-reviewed papers, conference contributions, etc.
 Contribute to programmatic outputs including results monitoring, reporting, budgeting, and branding.
 Contribute to the work of KIUSD teams, facilitating team building, learning and knowledge sharing and collaboration.
 Carry out other tasks relevant to support the overall objective of the position.


 Selection Criteria

 Master’s degree (or PhD) in Risk Modelling, Civil Engineering, Hydraulic Engineering, Hydrology, Risk Analysis, Disaster Risk Management, Geotechnical, and/or relevant fields.
 A minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience is required. Practical experience in disaster risk analysis, hydraulic and hydrological modeling modelling and other hazards is required
 Experience in producing technical deliverables including reports and presentations, project coordination, Technical Assistance (TA) is preferred.
 Working knowledge of World Bank operations, especially in disaster risk management, disaster risk financing and climate change adaptation projects. Prior working experience in TA in seismic, tropical cyclone and floods risk management within a World Bank project context is a plus.
 Strong experience working in disaster risk analytics and post-disaster assessments.
 Analytical: Consistently demonstrates the use of strong analytical skills to effectively interpret data and make informed decisions, leading to quality outcomes for clients and partners.
 Strong problem-solving skills and proven ability to apply these in carrying out research and operational tasks, presenting findings and recommendations, and contributing to resolution of sector and/or country issues.
 Practical experience in flood related infrastructure projects is desired.
 Demonstrated strong skills in engaging with clients on reform processes in at least one major business area; ability to engage on multiple business areas preferred.
 Proven familiarity with a range of technical solutions and how to adapt them to specific capacity and political economy contexts.
 Ability to work as part of a team and independently to produce high-quality outputs under tight time constraints.
 Ability to juggle numerous competing demands and priorities, respond quickly to management requests, and set priorities for self and others.
 Outstanding interpersonal and organizational skills, client-orientation, diplomatic skills, mature judgment, ability to collaborate with others in a multi-cultural environment, capacity to manage multiple tasks, identify and respond to needs as they arise, and remain flexible and self-motivated in a dynamic, fast-paced work environment.
 Experience collaborating with government agencies, international organizations, and community leaders.
 Fluency (written and spoken) in English is required. Fluency in an additional language such as French, Spanish or Portuguese is strongly desirable but not required.


 WBG Culture Attributes

 Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.
 Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
 Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.


 World Bank Group Core Competencies

As per WBG policy, an Extended Term (ET) appointment is subject to a lifetime maximum of three (3) years. Former and current ET staff who have completed or are in the process of completing their third-year ET appointment are not eligible for future ET appointments.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity and inclusive employer with a dedicated and committed workforce, and do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, religion, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability.

The GEMS team combines deep expertise in energy market design and modelling with practical impact.  Data Scientist – Weather & Short-Term Power (HL 14) 

 📍 Location: Brussels

 About ENGIE and Supply & Energy Management: 

 ENGIE, a global leader in low-carbon energy and services, relies on its Global Business Unit Supply & Energy Management (GBU S&EM) to provide reliable, sustainable, and affordable energy to all its customers. This strategic unit optimizes the Group’s and clients’ production assets and designs tailored energy solutions for our 200,000 professional clients and 15 million consumers.

 The Global Business Unit Supply & Energy Management leverages ENGIE’s assets to deliver secure and sustainable energy to its B2B and B2C customers. It uses its expertise in energy management to provide decarbonized electricity 24/7.

 Joining Supply & Energy Management means becoming part of a team of over 10,000 passionate experts spread across 20 countries, all united by a shared mission: shaping a greener and more efficient energy future. Together, we push the boundaries of innovation to deliver decarbonized energy 24/7. Join us and be part of those shaping the energy of tomorrow!

 Context 

 The Expertise Center Market Analysis and the Business Platform Power Trading, Structuring & Origination (PTSO) are looking for a Data Scientist – Weather & Short-Term Power to join the Short-Term Power Market Analysis (STP) team in Brussels. The position sits on the trading floor, embedded in an extended team of market analysts, meteorologists, hydrologists and data scientists.

The STP team covers short-term power markets — week-ahead, day-ahead, intraday, ancillary and imbalance — in support of trading and portfolio management activities in Central Western Europe (CWE). Weather has become the dominant driver of these markets: renewable generation, demand and prices are increasingly shaped by it, and extracting value from weather information is one of the team’s key priorities.

This is not a conventional power analyst position. We are looking for a data scientist with strong weather expertise, or a quantitative meteorologist, to act as a bridge between two teams: as a member of the STP team, the successful candidate will also be integrated in the Meteo & Climate team, strengthening the collaboration between them. Above all, the candidate will work in close daily contact with our internal clients: the short-term power trading and asset optimization desks.

 Your Mission 

 As Data Scientist – Weather & Short-Term Power, your mission is to turn weather data into market value: translating weather forecasts — and their uncertainty — into actionable signals, forecasts and strategies for the short-term power trading and asset optimization desks.

 Your main activities:

 Develop, industrialize and maintain weather-driven forecast products and trading signals for day-ahead, intraday and imbalance markets, owning the full model lifecycle from research to production.
 Exploit deterministic and ensemble weather forecasts (post-processing, calibration, skill evaluation) to extract predictive value for renewable generation, demand and prices in CWE.
 Work daily with the trading desks: understand their needs, deliver weather intelligence in actionable form, and communicate forecast confidence and risks clearly and on time.
 Act as the bridge between the STP and Meteo & Climate teams: co-develop tools and data pipelines, spread weather best practices within STP, and bring power market awareness to the weather team.
 Monitor upcoming weather and alert traders and analysts on market-moving weather events and forecast revisions.
 Contribute to the team’s roadmap, dashboards and digital platforms, staying ahead of advances in weather forecasting, data science and AI.


 Hard Skills

 What we are looking for 

 In-depth knowledge of Numerical Weather Prediction models and weather data, including ensemble forecasting and reanalysis datasets. 
 Strong Python and data science skills: machine learning applied to time series, statistical post-processing, uncertainty quantification, and handling of large meteorological datasets.
 Experience building, deploying and maintaining models in production; familiarity with cloud-based technologies (AWS, GCP or Azure) is a plus.
 Knowledge of (short-term) power markets is a plus — a strong appetite to learn them is a must.


 Soft Skills

 Clear and effective communication, written and verbal: able to convey complex weather and model topics to traders and non-specialists.
 Strong team spirit and collaborative mindset — you will operate across two teams and several desks.
 Reactivity, autonomy and composure in a fast-paced trading-floor environment.
 Curiosity, creativity and a solution-oriented attitude.


 Education & Experience

 Master’s degree or PhD in meteorology, atmospheric sciences, physics, applied mathematics, engineering or a related field. 
 3 to 5 years of experience in weather forecasting, data science applied to weather, or quantitative analysis — ideally in the energy sector.


 Languages

 Fluent in English.
 French and/or Dutch is a plus.


 Why join us? 

 A unique position at the crossroads of weather science and power trading, with direct daily exposure to trading decisions.
 Integration in two expert teams — Short-Term Power and Meteo & Climate — with genuine intellectual depth and a strong collaborative culture.
 Access to best-in-class weather data, proprietary data infrastructure and high-performance computing environments.
 Autonomy, real responsibilities and the possibility to grow, learn and develop, including attendance to conferences.


 Diversity & Inclusion 

 If you meet these requirements, then you are the talent we are looking for. Don’t wait – apply now with your CV.

At ENGIE S&EM, we are committed to fostering a gender-neutral and inclusive environment where everyone’s potential can thrive.

All our positions are open to people with disabilities . If you need any reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please inform your recruiter — we will be happy to support you.

 About ENGIE

 ENGIE is a global leader in low-carbon energy and services , committed to accelerating the transition towards a carbon-neutral world . Our purpose (“raison d’être”) is clear: act to reduce energy consumption and develop cleaner, more sustainable solutions that balance economic performance with a positive impact on people and the planet.

We rely on our core businesses — gas, power, renewable energy, and services — to deliver competitive, tailored solutions to our customers worldwide.

With 96,000 employees and a strong network of partners and stakeholders, ENGIE is more than a company: we are a community of Imaginative Builders , working every day to create harmonious, sustainable progress .

ENGIE is committed to promoting Equal Opportunity employment. We pro-actively foster an inclusive environment that not only embraces but celebrates diversity. Our goal is for all employees to experience a real sense of belonging . We aim to provide them with a safe and inclusive working environment in which they feel empowered to thrive and excel. Join us and embark on the adventure of the century. Be a transition maker , accomplish more and change our world! It's our reality. At ENGIE, we don’t just talk about change, we make it happen!

 Over Milliman

 Milliman is een van 's werelds grootste onafhankelijke adviesbureaus op het gebied van actuariaat, financieel risicomanagement en data science. Sinds 1947 helpen we organisaties wereldwijd bij het nemen van betere beslissingen op basis van data, analyses en diepgaande expertise.

Vanuit ons kantoor in Brussel werken we – samen met verzekeraars in België en de rest van de Benelux – aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken. Daarbij kunnen we rekenen op een internationaal netwerk van experts en collega's met uiteenlopende achtergronden.

 Meewerken aan actuariële en financiële analyses voor verzekeraars.

 Economist at the Supervision of insurance service 
 

 Would you like to contribute as a n economis t to better consumer protection and to increasing public trust in the financial sector
 ?Come and join the FSMA team and become an economist at the ‘Supervision of insurance’ service 
 WHERE WILL YOU BE WORKING? 
 

 You will be part of the ‘Supervision of Insurance’ service, which ensures that insurance companies comply with the rules as far as consumer protection is concerned.
 

 The work is highly varied, and includes supervision of advertisements, checking that insurance products provide sufficient value to the consumer, supervision of the complexity of insurance products, supervision of compliance with ESG rules, etc.
 

 In addition, the service also participates in the international activities of the European supervisory authority EIOPA.
 

 You will join a dynamic team with colleagues who are at the top of their profession and where quality is the highest priority.
 

 WHAT WILL YOUR JOB ENTAIL? 
 

 As an economist, you will be involved in all aspects of supervision. These include:
 Conducting economic analyses to determine whether insurance products offer sufficient value to the consumer (‘value for money’ analyses).
 Further developing the risk model further based on the various databases to which the FSMA has access.
 Working with colleagues in the service when supervising insurance products, including both life insurance (class 21, class 23, etc.) and non-life insurance products.
 Collaborating with the ‘Data analysis’ service to detect potential risks.
 Providing support to delineating the FSMA’s positions for the European supervisory authority EIOPA, and may participate in international working groups.
 

 WHAT KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS DO YOU BRING? 
 

 A Master’s degree in (applied) economics, business engineering or actuarial science.
 At least 2 years’ experience, preferably as an economist, risk manger or consultant in the financial sector or as a doctoral candidate.
 An explicit interest in the insurance sector and for the various new developments in that
 area.
 Ability to work on a team and to take initiative.Strong analytical skills and a capacity for synthesis. Ability to explain complex material in a way that is easy to understand.
 Capable of working in a goal-oriented and autonomous manner.
 A good knowledge of the commonly used Microsoft Office applications, and in particular Excel.
 Solid competence in Dutch and French and a good command of English.
 

 WHAT DO WE OFFER YOU? 
 

 A full-time job with a permanent contract.
 The chance to do your bit for consumer protection.
 A competitive salary package with many fringe benefits (including group and hospitalization insurance, full reimbursement of the costs of commuting to/from work, budget-friendly company dining room, contribution to your mobile phone and internet subscriptions, additional non-statutory holidays, bank holidays , etc.).
 A wide range of opportunities for learning and development.
 Flexible working hours.
 Good work/life balance (teleworking a few days
 a week).Opportunities for internal mobility.
 Offices within easy reach of Brussels city centre.
 

 Please note that each member of the FSMA staff is subj ect to a strict code o f ethics and is bound by the oblig ation of professiona l
 secrecy.

 Binnen ons Risk Management team zijn we op zoek naar een Senior Operational Risk Expert die een sleutelrol opneemt in het beheersen en beperken van niet‑financiële risico’s.

In deze rol ben je dé inhoudelijke referentie voor operationeel risicobeheer en fungeer je als kritische business partner voor management en directie.

Je zet je expertise in om een vertaling te maken van externe inzichten en regelgeving naar concrete toepassingen binnen de organisatie en bewaakt mee de kwaliteit en effectiviteit van het risicobeheer. Dankzij jouw scherpe analyse, onafhankelijk oordeel en overtuigingskracht help je de organisatie weloverwogen beslissingen te nemen en risico’s proactief te beheersen.

Niet zomaar een bank

Kom je bij ons aan boord? Dan merk je al snel dat Bank Van Breda geen doorsnee bank is. We zijn een bank specifiek voor ondernemers en vrije beroepen, zowel privé als professioneel, hun leven lang. Hun leefwereld, die kennen wij als geen ander. En dat is niet alles. Onze bedrijfscultuur is warm en bruist dankzij de onderlinge collegialiteit en zin voor initiatief. Toffe werksfeer? Check!

 Senior Operational Risk Expert met interesse in de bancaire sector

 Als Senior Operational Risk Expert Geef Je Richting Aan En Bouw Je Actief Mee Aan Een Sterk En Robuust Operationeel Risicokader

 Adviseren & ondersteunen

 Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor operationeel risicobeheer en waakt erover dat activiteiten verlopen in lijn met het beleid en de risico‑kaders van de bank.
 Je vertaalt jouw expertise naar de organisatie en draagt actief bij aan het Risk Appetite Framework en het beleid rond niet‑financiële risico’s.
 Je bewaakt de kwaliteit en naleving van het risicokader via onafhankelijke challenge, toezicht en opvolging.
 Je speelt een actieve rol als inhoudelijke business partner en hebt impact op strategie, governance en risicocultuur.
 Je neemt deel aan en draagt bij aan strategische discussies rond risico‑appetijt, niet‑financiële risico’s en prioriteiten.



 Expertise inzetten & versterken

 Je draagt actief bij aan het identificeren, beheersen en mitigeren van operationele risico’s, onder andere door:
 het proactief detecteren van (emerging) risico’s, met blik op externe ontwikkelingen, sectorinzichten en interne veranderingen;
 het kritisch challengen van actieplannen op inhoud, haalbaarheid, timing en restrisico;
 het formuleren van onderbouwde adviezen aan risicoverantwoordelijken en management;
 het uitvoeren en/of reviewen van risicogerichte controles en kwalitatieve deep dives;
 het opvolgen en escaleren van structurele risico’s en tekortkomingen waar nodig.
 Je adviseert bij nieuwe initiatieven en verandertrajecten en volgt de bijhorende risico’s nauw op.
 Je volgt wet- en regelgeving en toezichtsverwachtingen op en vertaalt deze naar interne kaders, processen en concrete toepassingen.
 Je blijft continu op de hoogte van relevante evoluties binnen jouw domein via o.a. vakliteratuur, sectorinitiatieven en netwerken.


 Coördinatie & samenwerking

 Je leidt één of meerdere risicocomités met stakeholders uit de eerste en tweede lijn.
 Je onderhoudt sterke relaties met toezichthouders en interne en externe stakeholders.
 Je werkt nauw samen met:
 beleidsmedewerkers rond rapportering, monitoring en control testing;
 het Process Office en proceseigenaars in de eerste lijn, met behoud van je onafhankelijke rol.
 Je brengt inhoudelijke expertise, challenge en advies binnen deze samenwerkingen.
 Je neemt het voortouw in projecten van A tot Z en stuurt daarbij functioneel een projectteam en stakeholders aan
 Natuurlijk kun je niet álles weten

 Onze organisatie is gericht op samenwerking en kennisdeling. Binnen je eigen team en in het hoofdkantoor voorzien we voor jou de nodige opleidingen en ondersteuning door verschillende specialisten. Je krijgt van ons een programma op maat, afgestemd op jouw persoonlijke tempo en stijl.

We waarderen jou

Jouw Inzet En Kennis Dragen Bij Tot Een Sterk Risicobeheer. Aan Al Dat Harde Werk Knopen We Natuurlijk Een Gepaste Verloning

 Een vast salaris waarbij je de mogelijkheid hebt om je 13de maand via een Flexplan te gebruiken voor bikelease, pensioensparen, internet, IT materiaal,...
 Een maandelijkse netto onkostenvergoeding.
 Een bedrijfswagen met tankkaart of wettelijk mobiliteitsbudget.
 De nieuwste iPhone met bijbehorend abonnement.
 Extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, fietsvergoeding, extra vakantiedagen en bank holidays.
 Mogelijkheid tot maximaal 50% thuiswerk en ruime glijtijden.
 Hospitalisatie-, invaliditeits- en groepsverzekering vanaf je eerste werkdag.
 Bij groei pluk jij daar de vruchten van dankzij ons winstdeelnameplan.
 Een fiscaalvriendelijke collectieve bonus wanneer de NPS-doelstellingen (Net Promotor Score) behaald worden.
 We investeren in jouw competenties met motiverende omkadering, gerichte coaching en interne/externe opleidingsmogelijkheden.



 Wist je trouwens dat Bank Van Breda in 2026 opnieuw tot de beste werkgevers van het land behoort volgens Great Place To Work, met een mooie tweede plaats?

Van kop tot teen. Of het scheelt niet veel.

 Je hebt een masterdiploma in een economische of juridische richting op zak.
 Je hebt 10 jaar ervaring met het beheren van risico’s in een bancaire of financiële context.
 Je kan risk-based een onderscheid maken tussen wat essentieel is en wat details zijn en op basis hiervan de juiste prioriteiten leggen.
 Je kan procesmatig denken en kan complexe materie in helder advies vertalen.
 Je bent een enthousiaste teamplayer met een positieve ingesteldheid. Als bruggenbouwer investeer je in een sterk intern netwerk.
 Je kan anderen overtuigen en draagvlak creëren om het risicobewustzijn te verhogen.
 Je hebt een zeer goede kennis van het Nederlands en durft jezelf ook in het Frans uit te drukken.



 Vink je niet het volledige lijstje af, maar voel je toch een onweerstaanbare kriebel om ons te contacteren? Doen! We ontdekken graag of het klikt.

Voor functies die vallen onder de regelgeving rond de bankierseed (wet van 22 april 2019), zal in het kader van het selectieproces gevraagd worden om een attest van de FSMA voor te leggen waaruit blijkt dat er geen beroepsverbod van toepassing is.

Bank Van Breda en haar medewerkers gaan zorgvuldig om met vertrouwelijke informatie, op een correcte en ethische manier. We koesteren diversiteit en verwelkomen mensen met verschillende achtergronden, ongeacht gender, functiebeperking, afkomst, levensbeschouwing, seksuele oriëntatie of leeftijd.
